1package com.noteworkshop.config;
2
3import com.noteworkshop.security.AdminInterceptor;
4import com.noteworkshop.security.AuthInterceptor;
5import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
6import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
7import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
8import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.CorsRegistry;
9import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.InterceptorRegistry;
10import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.ResourceHandlerRegistry;
11import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;
12
13import java.nio.file.Path;
14import java.nio.file.Paths;
15
16@Configuration
17@RequiredArgsConstructor
18public class WebMvcConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
19
20 private final AuthInterceptor authInterceptor;
21 private final AdminInterceptor adminInterceptor;
22
23 @Value("${app.upload-dir}")
24 private String uploadDir;
25
26 @Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins}")
27 private String allowedOrigins;
28
29 @Override
30 public void addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry registry) {
31 registry.addInterceptor(authInterceptor)
32 .addPathPatterns("/api/**")
33 .excludePathPatterns(
34 "/api/auth/**",
35 "/api/public/**",
36 "/api/health"
37 )
38 .order(1);
39
40 registry.addInterceptor(adminInterceptor)
41 .addPathPatterns("/api/admin/**")
42 .order(2);
43 }
44
45 @Override
46 public void addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry registry) {
47 registry.addMapping("/api/**")
48 .allowedOrigins(allowedOrigins.split(","))
49 .allowedMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS")
50 .allowedHeaders("*")
51 .allowCredentials(true)
52 .maxAge(3600);
53 }
54
55 @Override
56 public void addResourceHandlers(ResourceHandlerRegistry registry) {
57 Path dir = Paths.get(uploadDir).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
58 registry.addResourceHandler("/uploads/**")
59 .addResourceLocations(dir.toUri().toString());
60 }
61}

AuthInterceptor.java src/main/java/com/noteworkshop/security/AuthInterceptor.java 40 行 VS Code 打开
1package com.noteworkshop.security;
2
3import com.noteworkshop.common.BizException;
4import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
5import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
6import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
7import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
8import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor;
9
10@Component
11@RequiredArgsConstructor
12public class AuthInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
13
14 private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
15
16 @Override
17 public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
18 // 放行 CORS 预检请求，否则浏览器跨域调用会拿到 500
19 if ("OPTIONS".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
20 return true;
21 }
22 String header = request.getHeader("Authorization");
23 if (header == null || !header.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
24 throw new BizException(401, "未登录");
25 }
26 try {
27 UserContext.set(jwtUtil.userId(header.substring(7).trim()));
28 return true;
29 } catch (Exception e) {
30 throw new BizException(401, "登录已过期，请重新登录");
31 }
32 }
33
34 @Override
35 public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
36 Object handler, Exception ex) {
37 UserContext.clear();
38 }
39}

JwtUtil.java src/main/java/com/noteworkshop/security/JwtUtil.java 48 行 VS Code 打开
1package com.noteworkshop.security;
2
3import com.noteworkshop.config.JwtProperties;
4import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
5import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
6import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
7import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
8
9import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
10import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
11import java.time.Duration;
12import java.util.Date;
13
14@Component
15public class JwtUtil {
16
17 private final SecretKey key;
18 private final long expireMillis;
19
20 public JwtUtil(JwtProperties properties) {
21 this.key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(properties.getSecret().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
22 this.expireMillis = Duration.ofDays(properties.getExpireDays()).toMillis();
23 }
24
25 public String issue(Long userId, String username) {
26 Date now = new Date();
27 return Jwts.builder()
28 .subject(String.valueOf(userId))
29 .claim("username", username)
30 .issuedAt(now)
31 .expiration(new Date(now.getTime() + expireMillis))
32 .signWith(key)
33 .compact();
34 }
35
36 public Claims parse(String token) {
37 return Jwts.parser()
38 .verifyWith(key)
39 .build()
40 .parseSignedClaims(token)
41 .getPayload();
42 }
43
44 public Long userId(String token) {
45 return Long.valueOf(parse(token).getSubject());
46 }
47}

1package com.noteworkshop.user;
2
3import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.toolkit.Wrappers;
4import com.noteworkshop.common.BizException;
5import com.noteworkshop.security.JwtUtil;
6import com.noteworkshop.user.dto.AuthResponse;
7import com.noteworkshop.user.dto.LoginRequest;
8import com.noteworkshop.user.dto.ProfileRequest;
9import com.noteworkshop.user.dto.RegisterRequest;
10import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
11import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
12import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
13import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
14import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
15import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
16
17@Slf4j
18@Service
19@RequiredArgsConstructor
20public class UserService {
21
22 private final UserMapper userMapper;
23 private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
24 private final BCryptPasswordEncoder passwordEncoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
25
26 @Transactional
27 public User register(RegisterRequest request) {
28 Long count = userMapper.selectCount(
29 Wrappers.<User>lambdaQuery().eq(User::getUsername, request.username()));
30 if (count != null && count > 0) {
31 throw new BizException("用户名已存在");
32 }
33 User user = new User();
34 user.setUsername(request.username());
35 user.setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(request.password()));
36 user.setNickname(StringUtils.hasText(request.nickname()) ? request.nickname() : request.username());
37 user.setRole("USER");
38 user.setStatus(1);
39 userMapper.insert(user);
40 user.setPassword(null);
41 log.info("用户注册成功 username={} id={}", user.getUsername(), user.getId());
42 return user;
43 }
44
45 public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest request) {
46 User user = userMapper.selectOne(
47 Wrappers.<User>lambdaQuery().eq(User::getUsername, request.username()));
48 if (user == null || !passwordEncoder.matches(request.password(), user.getPassword())) {
49 throw new BizException(401, "用户名或密码错误");
50 }
51 if (user.getStatus() != null && user.getStatus() == 0) {
52 throw new BizException(403, "账号已被禁用");
53 }
54 String token = jwtUtil.issue(user.getId(), user.getUsername());
55 user.setPassword(null);
56 log.info("用户登录成功 username={} id={}", user.getUsername(), user.getId());
57 return new AuthResponse(token, user);
58 }
59
60 public User me(Long userId) {
61 User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
62 if (user == null) {
63 throw new BizException(404, "用户不存在");
64 }
65 user.setPassword(null);
66 return user;
67 }
68
69 @Transactional
70 public User updateProfile(Long userId, ProfileRequest request) {
71 User user = me(userId);
72 if (StringUtils.hasText(request.nickname())) {
73 user.setNickname(request.nickname());
74 }
75 if (request.bio() != null) {
76 user.setBio(request.bio());
77 }
78 if (StringUtils.hasText(request.avatar())) {
79 user.setAvatar(request.avatar());
80 }
81 user.setPassword(null);
82 userMapper.updateById(user);
83 return user;
84 }
85}

1package com.noteworkshop.note;
2
3import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.metadata.IPage;
4import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.toolkit.Wrappers;
5import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.plugins.pagination.Page;
6import com.noteworkshop.ai.NoteAi;
7import com.noteworkshop.ai.NoteAiMapper;
8import com.noteworkshop.comment.CommentService;
9import com.noteworkshop.common.BizException;
10import com.noteworkshop.common.PageResult;
11import com.noteworkshop.note.dto.NoteDetail;
12import com.noteworkshop.note.dto.NoteRequest;
13import com.noteworkshop.user.User;
14import com.noteworkshop.user.UserMapper;
15import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
16import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
17import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
18import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
19
20import java.util.Collections;
21import java.util.List;
22import java.util.Map;
23import java.util.function.Function;
24import java.util.stream.Collectors;
25
26@Service
27@RequiredArgsConstructor
28public class NoteService {
29
30 /** 笔记状态：正常 / 待审核 / 驳回 / 下架 */
31 public static final int STATUS_NORMAL = 1;
32 public static final int STATUS_PENDING = 2;
33 public static final int STATUS_REJECTED = 3;
34 public static final int STATUS_OFFLINE = 0;
35
36 private final NoteMapper noteMapper;
37 private final NoteImageMapper imageMapper;
38 private final NoteLikeMapper likeMapper;
39 private final UserMapper userMapper;
40 private final NoteAiMapper noteAiMapper;
41 private final CommentService commentService;
42
43 @Transactional
44 public NoteDetail create(Long userId, NoteRequest request) {
45 Note note = new Note();
46 note.setUserId(userId);
47 note.setBookName(request.bookName());
48 note.setTitle(request.title());
49 note.setContent(request.content());
50 boolean isPublic = request.isPublic() != null && request.isPublic() == 1;
51 note.setIsPublic(isPublic ? 1 : 0);
52 note.setStatus(isPublic ? STATUS_PENDING : STATUS_NORMAL);
53 note.setLikeCount(0);
54 note.setCommentCount(0);
55 noteMapper.insert(note);
56 saveImages(note.getId(), request.images());
57 return detail(note.getId(), userId);
58 }
59
60 @Transactional
61 public NoteDetail update(Long userId, Long noteId, NoteRequest request) {
62 Note note = requireOwned(userId, noteId);
63 boolean isPublic = request.isPublic() != null && request.isPublic() == 1;
64 note.setBookName(request.bookName());
65 note.setTitle(request.title());
66 note.setContent(request.content());
67 note.setIsPublic(isPublic ? 1 : 0);
68 note.setStatus(isPublic ? STATUS_PENDING : STATUS_NORMAL);
69 note.setRejectReason(null);
70 note.setReviewedAt(null);
71 noteMapper.updateById(note);
72 imageMapper.delete(Wrappers.<NoteImage>lambdaQuery().eq(NoteImage::getNoteId, noteId));
73 saveImages(noteId, request.images());
74 return detail(noteId, userId);
75 }
76
77 @Transactional
78 public void delete(Long userId, Long noteId) {
79 requireOwned(userId, noteId);
80 commentService.deleteByNote(noteId);
81 noteAiMapper.delete(Wrappers.<NoteAi>lambdaQuery().eq(NoteAi::getNoteId, noteId));
82 noteMapper.deleteById(noteId);
83 imageMapper.delete(Wrappers.<NoteImage>lambdaQuery().eq(NoteImage::getNoteId, noteId));
84 likeMapper.delete(Wrappers.<NoteLike>lambdaQuery().eq(NoteLike::getNoteId, noteId));
85 }
86
87 public PageResult<Note> listMine(Long userId, long page, long size) {
88 Page<Note> p = noteMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size),
89 Wrappers.<Note>lambdaQuery()
90 .eq(Note::getUserId, userId)
91 .orderByDesc(Note::getCreatedAt));
92 return PageResult.of(p);
93 }
94
95 public PageResult<Note> listPublic(long page, long size, String sort) {
96 var query = Wrappers.<Note>lambdaQuery()
97 .eq(Note::getIsPublic, 1)
98 .eq(Note::getStatus, STATUS_NORMAL);
99 if ("hot".equalsIgnoreCase(sort)) {
100 query.orderByDesc(Note::getLikeCount).orderByDesc(Note::getCreatedAt);
101 } else {
102 query.orderByDesc(Note::getCreatedAt);
103 }
104 Page<Note> p = noteMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size), query);
105 attachAuthors(p.getRecords());
106 return PageResult.of(p);
107 }
108
109 public PageResult<Note> listPublicByAuthor(Long authorId, long page, long size) {
110 Page<Note> p = noteMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size),
111 Wrappers.<Note>lambdaQuery()
112 .eq(Note::getUserId, authorId)
113 .eq(Note::getIsPublic, 1)
114 .eq(Note::getStatus, STATUS_NORMAL)
115 .orderByDesc(Note::getCreatedAt));
116 attachAuthors(p.getRecords());
117 return PageResult.of(p);
118 }
119
120 public NoteDetail detail(Long noteId, Long currentUserId) {
121 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
122 if (note == null) {
123 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在");
124 }
125 boolean owner = currentUserId != null && currentUserId.equals(note.getUserId());
126 if (!owner) {
127 boolean visible = note.getIsPublic() != null && note.getIsPublic() == 1
128 && note.getStatus() != null && note.getStatus() == STATUS_NORMAL;
129 if (!visible) {
130 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在或未公开");
131 }
132 }
133 List<String> images = imageUrls(noteId);
134 boolean liked = currentUserId != null && likeMapper.selectCount(
135 Wrappers.<NoteLike>lambdaQuery()
136 .eq(NoteLike::getUserId, currentUserId)
137 .eq(NoteLike::getNoteId, noteId)) > 0;
138 note.setImages(images);
139 note.setLiked(liked);
140 attachAuthor(note);
141 NoteAi ai = noteAiMapper.selectOne(Wrappers.<NoteAi>lambdaQuery()
142 .eq(NoteAi::getNoteId, noteId).last("limit 1"));
143 return new NoteDetail(note, images, liked,
144 ai == null ? null : ai.getType(),
145 ai == null ? null : ai.getContent());
146 }
147
148 @Transactional
149 public Map<String, Object> toggleLike(Long userId, Long noteId) {
150 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
151 if (note == null) {
152 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在");
153 }
154 if (note.getIsPublic() == null || note.getIsPublic() != 1
155 || note.getStatus() == null || note.getStatus() != STATUS_NORMAL) {
156 throw new BizException(400, "只能点赞公开且审核通过的笔记");
157 }
158 Long exists = likeMapper.selectCount(Wrappers.<NoteLike>lambdaQuery()
159 .eq(NoteLike::getUserId, userId)
160 .eq(NoteLike::getNoteId, noteId));
161 boolean liked;
162 if (exists > 0) {
163 likeMapper.delete(Wrappers.<NoteLike>lambdaQuery()
164 .eq(NoteLike::getUserId, userId)
165 .eq(NoteLike::getNoteId, noteId));
166 noteMapper.update(null, Wrappers.<Note>lambdaUpdate()
167 .eq(Note::getId, noteId)
168 .setSql("like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0)"));
169 liked = false;
170 } else {
171 NoteLike like = new NoteLike();
172 like.setUserId(userId);
173 like.setNoteId(noteId);
174 likeMapper.insert(like);
175 noteMapper.update(null, Wrappers.<Note>lambdaUpdate()
176 .eq(Note::getId, noteId)
177 .setSql("like_count = like_count + 1"));
178 liked = true;
179 }
180 Note latest = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
181 return Map.of("liked", liked, "likeCount", latest.getLikeCount());
182 }
183
184 public PageResult<Note> listLiked(Long userId, long page, long size) {
185 IPage<NoteLike> likePage = likeMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size),
186 Wrappers.<NoteLike>lambdaQuery()
187 .eq(NoteLike::getUserId, userId)
188 .orderByDesc(NoteLike::getCreatedAt));
189 if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(likePage.getRecords())) {
190 return PageResult.of(Collections.emptyList(), 0, page, size);
191 }
192 List<Long> noteIds = likePage.getRecords().stream().map(NoteLike::getNoteId).toList();
193 Map<Long, Note> noteMap = noteMapper.selectByIds(noteIds).stream()
194 .collect(Collectors.toMap(Note::getId, Function.identity()));
195 List<Note> notes = noteIds.stream()
196 .map(noteMap::get)
197 .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
198 .toList();
199 attachAuthors(notes);
200 return PageResult.of(notes, likePage.getTotal(), page, size);
201 }
202
203 /** 供 AI 模块使用：校验笔记归属 */
204 public Note requireOwned(Long userId, Long noteId) {
205 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
206 if (note == null) {
207 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在");
208 }
209 if (!note.getUserId().equals(userId)) {
210 throw new BizException(403, "无权操作他人的笔记");
211 }
212 return note;
213 }
214
215 private void saveImages(Long noteId, List<String> urls) {
216 if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(urls)) {
217 return;
218 }
219 int sort = 0;
220 for (String url : urls) {
221 NoteImage image = new NoteImage();
222 image.setNoteId(noteId);
223 image.setUrl(url);
224 image.setSort(sort++);
225 imageMapper.insert(image);
226 }
227 }
228
229 private List<String> imageUrls(Long noteId) {
230 return imageMapper.selectList(Wrappers.<NoteImage>lambdaQuery()
231 .eq(NoteImage::getNoteId, noteId)
232 .orderByAsc(NoteImage::getSort))
233 .stream().map(NoteImage::getUrl).toList();
234 }
235
236 private void attachAuthors(List<Note> notes) {
237 if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(notes)) {
238 return;
239 }
240 List<Long> userIds = notes.stream().map(Note::getUserId).distinct().toList();
241 Map<Long, User> users = userMapper.selectByIds(userIds).stream()
242 .collect(Collectors.toMap(User::getId, Function.identity()));
243 for (Note note : notes) {
244 User author = users.get(note.getUserId());
245 if (author != null) {
246 note.setAuthorName(author.getNickname());
247 note.setAuthorAvatar(author.getAvatar());
248 }
249 }
250 }
251
252 private void attachAuthor(Note note) {
253 User author = userMapper.selectById(note.getUserId());
254 if (author != null) {
255 note.setAuthorName(author.getNickname());
256 note.setAuthorAvatar(author.getAvatar());
257 }
258 }
259}

13import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
14import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
15
16import java.util.ArrayDeque;
17import java.util.ArrayList;
18import java.util.Deque;
19import java.util.HashMap;
20import java.util.HashSet;
21import java.util.List;
22import java.util.Map;
23import java.util.Set;
24import java.util.function.Function;
25import java.util.stream.Collectors;
26
27@Slf4j
28@Service
29@RequiredArgsConstructor
30public class CommentService {
31
32 private final CommentMapper commentMapper;
33 private final NoteMapper noteMapper;
34 private final UserMapper userMapper;
35
36 public List<CommentVO> listByNote(Long noteId) {
37 // 评论跟随笔记可见性：私有/待审核/已下架的笔记，评论不对外暴露
38 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
39 if (note == null || note.getStatus() == null || note.getStatus() != 1
40 || note.getIsPublic() == null || note.getIsPublic() != 1) {
41 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在或未公开");
42 }
43 List<Comment> comments = commentMapper.selectList(Wrappers.<Comment>lambdaQuery()
44 .eq(Comment::getNoteId, noteId)
45 .eq(Comment::getDeleted, 0)
46 .orderByAsc(Comment::getId));
47 if (comments.isEmpty()) {
48 return List.of();
49 }
50 Map<Long, User> users = userMapper.selectByIds(
51 comments.stream().map(Comment::getUserId).distinct().toList())
52 .stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(User::getId, Function.identity()));
53
54 Map<Long, CommentVO> voMap = new HashMap<>();
55 for (Comment c : comments) {
56 User u = users.get(c.getUserId());
57 voMap.put(c.getId(), CommentVO.of(c.getId(), c.getNoteId(), c.getUserId(),
58 u == null ? "已注销用户" : u.getNickname(),
59 u == null ? null : u.getAvatar(),
60 c.getParentId(), c.getContent(), c.getCreatedAt()));
61 }
62 List<CommentVO> roots = new ArrayList<>();
63 for (Comment c : comments) {
64 CommentVO vo = voMap.get(c.getId());
65 CommentVO parent = voMap.get(c.getParentId());
66 if (c.getParentId() == null || c.getParentId() == 0 || parent == null) {
67 roots.add(vo);
68 } else {
69 parent.children().add(vo);
70 }
71 }
72 return roots;
73 }
74
75 @Transactional
76 public CommentVO add(Long userId, Long noteId, CommentRequest request) {
77 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
78 if (note == null || note.getStatus() == null || note.getStatus() != 1
79 || note.getIsPublic() == null || note.getIsPublic() != 1) {
80 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在或未公开");
81 }
82 Long parentId = request.parentId() == null ? 0L : request.parentId();
83 if (parentId != 0) {
84 Comment parent = commentMapper.selectById(parentId);
85 if (parent == null || parent.getDeleted() == 1 || !parent.getNoteId().equals(noteId)) {
86 throw new BizException(400, "回复的评论不存在");
87 }
88 }
89 Comment comment = new Comment();
90 comment.setNoteId(noteId);
91 comment.setUserId(userId);
92 comment.setParentId(parentId);
93 comment.setContent(request.content());
94 comment.setDeleted(0);
95 commentMapper.insert(comment);
96 noteMapper.update(null, Wrappers.<Note>lambdaUpdate()
97 .eq(Note::getId, noteId)
98 .setSql("comment_count = comment_count + 1"));
99
100 User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
101 log.info("用户 {} 评论了笔记 {}", userId, noteId);
102 return CommentVO.of(comment.getId(), noteId, userId,
103 user == null ? "" : user.getNickname(),
104 user == null ? null : user.getAvatar(),
105 parentId, comment.getContent(), comment.getCreatedAt());
106 }
107
108 @Transactional
109 public void delete(Long userId, Long commentId) {
110 Comment comment = commentMapper.selectById(commentId);
111 if (comment == null || comment.getDeleted() == 1) {
112 throw new BizException(404, "评论不存在");
113 }
114 if (!comment.getUserId().equals(userId)) {
115 throw new BizException(403, "只能删除自己的评论");
116 }
117 removeCascade(comment);
118 }
119
120 @Transactional
121 public void adminDelete(Long commentId) {
122 Comment comment = commentMapper.selectById(commentId);
123 if (comment == null || comment.getDeleted() == 1) {
124 throw new BizException(404, "评论不存在");
125 }
126 removeCascade(comment);
127 log.info("管理员删除评论 {}", commentId);
128 }
129
130 /** 笔记被删除时，级联逻辑删除其全部评论 */
131 @Transactional
132 public void deleteByNote(Long noteId) {
133 commentMapper.update(null, Wrappers.<Comment>lambdaUpdate()
134 .eq(Comment::getNoteId, noteId)
135 .eq(Comment::getDeleted, 0)
136 .set(Comment::getDeleted, 1));
137 }
138
139 /** 逻辑删除该评论及其所有子孙评论 */
140 private void removeCascade(Comment root) {
141 List<Comment> all = commentMapper.selectList(Wrappers.<Comment>lambdaQuery()
142 .eq(Comment::getNoteId, root.getNoteId())
143 .eq(Comment::getDeleted, 0));
144 Map<Long, List<Comment>> childrenMap = all.stream()
145 .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(c -> c.getParentId() == null ? 0L : c.getParentId()));
146
147 Set<Long> toDelete = new HashSet<>();
148 Deque<Long> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
149 queue.add(root.getId());
150 toDelete.add(root.getId());
151 while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
152 Long current = queue.poll();
153 for (Comment child : childrenMap.getOrDefault(current, List.of())) {
154 if (toDelete.add(child.getId())) {
155 queue.add(child.getId());
156 }
157 }
158 }
159 commentMapper.update(null, Wrappers.<Comment>lambdaUpdate()
160 .in(Comment::getId, toDelete)
161 .set(Comment::getDeleted, 1));
162 noteMapper.update(null, Wrappers.<Note>lambdaUpdate()
163 .eq(Note::getId, root.getNoteId())
164 .setSql("comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - " + toDelete.size() + ", 0)"));
165 }
166}

3import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.toolkit.Wrappers;

22@Service
23@RequiredArgsConstructor
24public class FollowService {
25
26 private final FollowMapper followMapper;
27 private final UserMapper userMapper;
28 private final NoteMapper noteMapper;
29
30 @Transactional
31 public Map<String, Object> follow(Long userId, Long targetId) {
32 if (userId.equals(targetId)) {
33 throw new BizException("不能关注自己");
34 }
35 User target = userMapper.selectById(targetId);
36 if (target == null) {
37 throw new BizException(404, "用户不存在");
38 }
39 Long exists = followMapper.selectCount(Wrappers.<Follow>lambdaQuery()
40 .eq(Follow::getFollowerId, userId)
41 .eq(Follow::getFolloweeId, targetId));
42 if (exists == null || exists == 0) {
43 Follow follow = new Follow();
44 follow.setFollowerId(userId);
45 follow.setFolloweeId(targetId);
46 followMapper.insert(follow);
47 }
48 return Map.of("followed", true, "fansCount", fansCount(targetId));
49 }
50
51 @Transactional
52 public Map<String, Object> unfollow(Long userId, Long targetId) {
53 followMapper.delete(Wrappers.<Follow>lambdaQuery()
54 .eq(Follow::getFollowerId, userId)
55 .eq(Follow::getFolloweeId, targetId));
56 return Map.of("followed", false, "fansCount", fansCount(targetId));
57 }
58
59 public long fansCount(Long userId) {
60 return followMapper.selectCount(Wrappers.<Follow>lambdaQuery()
61 .eq(Follow::getFolloweeId, userId));
62 }
63
64 public PageResult<User> followers(Long targetId, long page, long size) {
65 Page<Follow> p = followMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size),
66 Wrappers.<Follow>lambdaQuery()
67 .eq(Follow::getFolloweeId, targetId)
68 .orderByDesc(Follow::getCreatedAt));
69 return toUsers(p, Follow::getFollowerId, page, size);
70 }
71
72 public PageResult<User> following(Long userId, long page, long size) {
73 Page<Follow> p = followMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size),
74 Wrappers.<Follow>lambdaQuery()
75 .eq(Follow::getFollowerId, userId)
76 .orderByDesc(Follow::getCreatedAt));
77 return toUsers(p, Follow::getFolloweeId, page, size);
78 }
79
80 public AuthorVO profile(Long targetId, Long currentUserId) {
81 User user = userMapper.selectById(targetId);
82 if (user == null) {
83 throw new BizException(404, "用户不存在");
84 }
85 long notes = noteMapper.selectCount(Wrappers.<Note>lambdaQuery()
86 .eq(Note::getUserId, targetId)
87 .eq(Note::getIsPublic, 1)
88 .eq(Note::getStatus, 1));
89 boolean followed = currentUserId != null && followMapper.selectCount(
90 Wrappers.<Follow>lambdaQuery()
91 .eq(Follow::getFollowerId, currentUserId)
92 .eq(Follow::getFolloweeId, targetId)) > 0;
93 return new AuthorVO(user.getId(), user.getNickname(), user.getAvatar(), user.getBio(),
94 fansCount(targetId), notes, followed);
95 }
96
97 /** 热门作者：按粉丝数倒序 */
98 public List<AuthorVO> hotAuthors(int limit) {
99 List<Map<String, Object>> rows = followMapper.selectMaps(
100 Wrappers.<Follow>query()
101 .select("followee_id", "count(*) as cnt")
102 .groupBy("followee_id")
103 .orderByDesc("cnt")
104 .last("limit " + Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, 50))));
105 if (rows.isEmpty()) {
106 return List.of();
107 }
108 List<Long> ids = rows.stream()
109 .map(r -> ((Number) r.get("followee_id")).longValue())
110 .toList();
111 Map<Long, User> users = userMapper.selectByIds(ids).stream()
112 .collect(Collectors.toMap(User::getId, Function.identity()));
113 List<AuthorVO> result = new ArrayList<>();
114 for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
115 Long id = ((Number) row.get("followee_id")).longValue();
116 User u = users.get(id);
117 if (u == null) {
118 continue;
119 }
120 result.add(new AuthorVO(u.getId(), u.getNickname(), u.getAvatar(), u.getBio(),
121 ((Number) row.get("cnt")).longValue(),
122 noteMapper.selectCount(Wrappers.<Note>lambdaQuery()
123 .eq(Note::getUserId, id)
124 .eq(Note::getIsPublic, 1)
125 .eq(Note::getStatus, 1)),
126 false));
127 }
128 return result;
129 }
130
131 private PageResult<User> toUsers(Page<Follow> p, Function<Follow, Long> idGetter, long page, long size) {
132 if (p.getRecords().isEmpty()) {
133 return PageResult.of(List.of(), p.getTotal(), page, size);
134 }
135 List<Long> ids = p.getRecords().stream().map(idGetter).toList();
136 Map<Long, User> users = userMapper.selectByIds(ids).stream()
137 .collect(Collectors.toMap(User::getId, Function.identity()));
138 List<User> ordered = ids.stream()
139 .map(users::get)
140 .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
141 .peek(u -> u.setPassword(null))
142 .toList();
143 return PageResult.of(ordered, p.getTotal(), page, size);
144 }
145}

85
86 public PageResult<Note> notes(long page, long size, Integer status, String keyword) {
87 var query = Wrappers.<Note>lambdaQuery().orderByDesc(Note::getCreatedAt);
88 if (status != null) {
89 query.eq(Note::getStatus, status);
90 }
91 if (StringUtils.hasText(keyword)) {
92 query.and(w -> w.like(Note::getTitle, keyword).or().like(Note::getBookName, keyword));
93 }
94 return PageResult.of(noteMapper.selectPage(new Page<>(page, size), query));
95 }
96
97 @Transactional
98 public void review(Long noteId, boolean approved, String reason) {
99 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
100 if (note == null) {
101 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在");
102 }
103 if (note.getStatus() == null || note.getStatus() != NoteService.STATUS_PENDING) {
104 throw new BizException(400, "该笔记不在待审核状态");
105 }
106 note.setStatus(approved ? NoteService.STATUS_NORMAL : NoteService.STATUS_REJECTED);
107 note.setRejectReason(approved ? null : (StringUtils.hasText(reason) ? reason : "内容不符合公开规范"));
108 note.setReviewedAt(LocalDateTime.now());
109 noteMapper.updateById(note);
110 log.info("笔记审核 noteId={} approved={} reason={}", noteId, approved, note.getRejectReason());
111 }
112
113 @Transactional
114 public void takeDown(Long noteId) {
115 Note note = noteMapper.selectById(noteId);
116 if (note == null) {
117 throw new BizException(404, "笔记不存在");
118 }
119 note.setStatus(NoteService.STATUS_OFFLINE);
120 noteMapper.updateById(note);
121 log.info("管理员下架笔记 noteId={}", noteId);
122 }
123
124 public void deleteComment(Long commentId) {
125 commentService.adminDelete(commentId);
126 }
127
128 public Map<String, Object> aiStats() {
129 long total = aiCallLogMapper.selectCount(null);
130 long success = aiCallLogMapper.selectCount(Wrappers.<AiCallLog>lambdaQuery()
131 .eq(AiCallLog::getSuccess, 1));
132 List<Map<String, Object>> rows = aiCallLogMapper.selectMaps(
133 Wrappers.<AiCallLog>query()
134 .select("scene", "count(*) as total",
135 "sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as success")
136 .groupBy("scene"));
137 Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
138 map.put("total", total);
139 map.put("success", success);
140 map.put("fail", total - success);
141 map.put("byScene", rows);
142 return map;
143 }
144}

1package com.noteworkshop.ai;
2
3import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.toolkit.Wrappers;
4import com.noteworkshop.ai.dto.ChatRequest;
5import com.noteworkshop.common.BizException;
6import com.noteworkshop.note.Note;
7import com.noteworkshop.note.NoteService;
8import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
9import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
10import org.springframework.ai.chat.client.ChatClient;
11import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
12import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
13import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
14
15import java.time.LocalDateTime;
16import java.util.ArrayList;
17import java.util.Collections;
18import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
19import java.util.List;
20import java.util.Map;
21
22@Slf4j
23@Service
24@RequiredArgsConstructor
25public class AiService {
26
27 private static final String NOTE_SYSTEM_PROMPT =
28 "你是「笔记工坊」的读书笔记助手，输出使用简体中文，只依据用户给出的笔记内容作答，不要编造。";
29
30 private final ChatClient.Builder chatClientBuilder;
31 private final AiProperties aiProperties;
32 private final NoteAiMapper noteAiMapper;
33 private final AiCallLogMapper callLogMapper;
34 private final AiChatSessionMapper sessionMapper;
35 private final AiChatMessageMapper messageMapper;
36 private final NoteService noteService;
37
38 private volatile ChatClient chatClient;
39
40 private ChatClient client() {
41 if (chatClient == null) {
42 synchronized (this) {
43 if (chatClient == null) {
44 chatClient = chatClientBuilder.build();
45 }
46 }
47 }
48 return chatClient;
49 }
50
51 public Map<String, Object> status() {
52 Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
53 map.put("enabled", aiProperties.isEnabled());
54 map.put("scenes", List.of("SUMMARY", "AUDIENCE", "SCORE", "CHAT"));
55 map.put("note", "需要配置环境变量 AI_API_KEY / AI_BASE_URL / AI_MODEL 后才能真正调用大模型");
56 return map;
57 }
58
59 public Map<String, Object> generate(Long userId, Long noteId, String type) {
60 ensureEnabled();
61 Note note = noteService.requireOwned(userId, noteId);
62 String prompt = buildNotePrompt(note, type);
63 long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
64 try {
65 String content = callAi(NOTE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt);
66 logCall(userId, type, true, null, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
67 Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
68 map.put("type", type);
69 map.put("content", content);
70 map.put("saved", false);
71 return map;
72 } catch (Exception e) {
73 logCall(userId, type, false, e.getMessage(), System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
74 log.warn("AI 调用失败 type={} noteId={}", type, noteId, e);
75 throw new BizException(503, "AI 服务暂不可用：" + brief(e.getMessage()));
76 }
77 }
78
79 @Transactional
80 public Map<String, Object> save(Long userId, Long noteId, String type, String content) {
81 noteService.requireOwned(userId, noteId);
82 NoteAi existing = noteAiMapper.selectOne(Wrappers.<NoteAi>lambdaQuery()
83 .eq(NoteAi::getNoteId, noteId).last("limit 1"));
84 if (existing == null) {
85 NoteAi ai = new NoteAi();
86 ai.setNoteId(noteId);
87 ai.setType(type);
88 ai.setContent(content);
89 noteAiMapper.insert(ai);
90 } else {
91 existing.setType(type);
92 existing.setContent(content);
93 noteAiMapper.updateById(existing);
94 }
95 Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
96 map.put("type", type);
97 map.put("content", content);
98 map.put("saved", true);
99 return map;
100 }
101
102 public Map<String, Object> get(Long noteId) {
103 NoteAi ai = noteAiMapper.selectOne(Wrappers.<NoteAi>lambdaQuery()
104 .eq(NoteAi::getNoteId, noteId).last("limit 1"));
105 Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
106 map.put("type", ai == null ? null : ai.getType());
107 map.put("content", ai == null ? null : ai.getContent());
108 map.put("savedAt", ai == null ? null : ai.getCreatedAt());
109 return map;
110 }
111
112 /**
113 * 不加事务：AI 调用失败时，用户消息与调用日志需要保留（日志用于统计失败次数）
114 */
115 public Map<String, Object> chat(Long userId, ChatRequest request) {
116 ensureEnabled();
117 AiChatSession session;
118 if (request.sessionId() == null) {
119 session = new AiChatSession();
120 session.setUserId(userId);
121 session.setTitle(shortTitle(request.message()));
122 sessionMapper.insert(session);
123 } else {
124 session = requireSession(userId, request.sessionId());
125 }
126
127 List<AiChatMessage> history = messageMapper.selectList(Wrappers.<AiChatMessage>lambdaQuery()
128 .eq(AiChatMessage::getSessionId, session.getId())
129 .orderByDesc(AiChatMessage::getId)
130 .last("limit " + aiProperties.getWindowSize()));
131 Collections.reverse(history);
132
133 AiChatMessage userMessage = new AiChatMessage();
134 userMessage.setSessionId(session.getId());
135 userMessage.setRole("user");
136 userMessage.setContent(request.message());
137 messageMapper.insert(userMessage);
138
139 String prompt = buildChatPrompt(history, request.message());
140 long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
141 String reply;
142 try {
143 reply = callAi(aiProperties.getSystemPrompt(), prompt);
144 logCall(userId, "CHAT", true, null, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
145 } catch (Exception e) {
146 logCall(userId, "CHAT", false, e.getMessage(), System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
147 log.warn("AI 客服调用失败 sessionId={}", session.getId(), e);
148 throw new BizException(503, "AI 服务暂不可用：" + brief(e.getMessage()));
149 }
150
151 AiChatMessage assistantMessage = new AiChatMessage();
152 assistantMessage.setSessionId(session.getId());
153 assistantMessage.setRole("assistant");
154 assistantMessage.setContent(reply);
155 messageMapper.insert(assistantMessage);
156
157 session.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());
158 sessionMapper.updateById(session);
159
160 Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
161 map.put("sessionId", session.getId());
162 map.put("title", session.getTitle());
163 map.put("reply", reply);
164 return map;
165 }
166
167 public List<AiChatSession> sessions(Long userId) {
168 return sessionMapper.selectList(Wrappers.<AiChatSession>lambdaQuery()
169 .eq(AiChatSession::getUserId, userId)
170 .orderByDesc(AiChatSession::getUpdatedAt)
171 .orderByDesc(AiChatSession::getId));
172 }
173
174 public List<AiChatMessage> messages(Long userId, Long sessionId) {
175 requireSession(userId, sessionId);
176 return messageMapper.selectList(Wrappers.<AiChatMessage>lambdaQuery()
177 .eq(AiChatMessage::getSessionId, sessionId)
178 .orderByAsc(AiChatMessage::getId));
179 }
180
181 @Transactional
182 public void deleteSession(Long userId, Long sessionId) {
183 requireSession(userId, sessionId);
184 messageMapper.delete(Wrappers.<AiChatMessage>lambdaQuery()
185 .eq(AiChatMessage::getSessionId, sessionId));
186 sessionMapper.deleteById(sessionId);
187 }
188
189 private AiChatSession requireSession(Long userId, Long sessionId) {
190 AiChatSession session = sessionMapper.selectById(sessionId);
191 if (session == null) {
192 throw new BizException(404, "会话不存在");
193 }
194 if (!session.getUserId().equals(userId)) {
195 throw new BizException(403, "无权访问他人的会话");
196 }
197 return session;
198 }
199
200 private String callAi(String system, String user) {
201 return client().prompt()
202 .system(system)
203 .user(user)
204 .call()
205 .content();
206 }
207
208 private String buildNotePrompt(Note note, String type) {
209 String body = "书名：" + note.getBookName() + "\n标题：" + note.getTitle() + "\n正文：\n" + note.getContent();
210 return switch (type) {
211 case "SUMMARY" -> "请阅读下面的读书笔记，用不超过 200 字总结核心内容与要点，直接输出总结正文。\n\n" + body;
212 case "AUDIENCE" -> "请根据下面的读书笔记，推荐 3 类最适合阅读它的人群，并分别说明理由。\n\n" + body;
213 case "SCORE" -> "请从「内容完整性」「整体相关性」「思考深度」三个维度给下面的读书笔记打分（每项 10 分），"
214 + "给出总分（30 分制）和一句改进建议。\n\n" + body;
215 default -> throw new BizException(400, "不支持的 AI 类型");
216 };
217 }
218
219 private String buildChatPrompt(List<AiChatMessage> history, String message) {
220 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
221 if (!history.isEmpty()) {
222 sb.append("以下是本会话最近的历史对话，请结合上下文回答最后一个问题：\n");
223 for (AiChatMessage m : history) {
224 sb.append("user".equals(m.getRole()) ? "用户：" : "助手：")
225 .append(m.getContent()).append('\n');
226 }
227 sb.append('\n');
228 }
229 sb.append("用户：").append(message);
230 return sb.toString();
231 }
232
233 private void ensureEnabled() {
234 if (!aiProperties.isEnabled()) {
235 throw new BizException(503, "AI 功能未启用（设置 AI_ENABLED=true 并配置 AI_API_KEY）");
236 }
237 }
238
239 private void logCall(Long userId, String scene, boolean success, String error, long latency) {
240 try {
241 AiCallLog log = new AiCallLog();
242 log.setUserId(userId);
243 log.setScene(scene);
244 log.setSuccess(success ? 1 : 0);
245 log.setErrorMsg(error == null ? null : brief(error));
246 log.setLatencyMs((int) Math.min(latency, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
247 callLogMapper.insert(log);
248 } catch (Exception e) {
249 log.warn("写入 AI 调用日志失败", e);
250 }
251 }
252
253 private String brief(String text) {
254 if (!StringUtils.hasText(text)) {
255 return "未知错误";
256 }
257 return text.length() <= 240 ? text : text.substring(0, 240);
258 }
259
260 private String shortTitle(String message) {
261 String t = message.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
262 return t.length() <= 20 ? t : t.substring(0, 20);
263 }
264}

1package com.noteworkshop.file;
2
3import com.noteworkshop.common.BizException;
4import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
5import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
6import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
7import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
8
9import java.io.IOException;
10import java.nio.file.Files;
11import java.nio.file.Path;
12import java.nio.file.Paths;
13import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
14import java.util.Locale;
15import java.util.Set;
16import java.util.UUID;
17
18@Slf4j
19@Service
20public class FileStorageService {
21
22 private static final Set<String> ALLOWED = Set.of("jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp");
23
24 @Value("${app.upload-dir}")
25 private String uploadDir;
26
27 public String store(MultipartFile file) {
28 if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {
29 throw new BizException("请选择要上传的文件");
30 }
31 String original = file.getOriginalFilename() == null ? "" : file.getOriginalFilename();
32 String ext = original.contains(".")
33 ? original.substring(original.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
34 : "";
35 if (!ALLOWED.contains(ext)) {
36 throw new BizException("只支持 " + ALLOWED + " 格式的图片");
37 }
38 try {
39 Path base = Paths.get(uploadDir).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
40 Files.createDirectories(base);
41 String name = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "") + "." + ext;
42 Path target = base.resolve(name);
43 try (var in = file.getInputStream()) {
44 Files.copy(in, target, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
45 }
46 log.info("文件上传成功 original={} saved={} size={}", original, name, file.getSize());
47 return "/uploads/" + name;
48 } catch (IOException e) {
49 throw new BizException(500, "文件保存失败");
50 }
51 }
52}

1import axios from 'axios'
2
3const http = axios.create({
4 baseURL: '',
5 timeout: 15000
6})
7
8let redirectingToLogin = false
9
10function clearAuthStorage() {
11 localStorage.removeItem('nw_token')
12 localStorage.removeItem('nw_user')
13}
14
15function redirectToLogin() {
16 clearAuthStorage()
17 if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
18 if (window.location.pathname === '/login' || redirectingToLogin) return
19 redirectingToLogin = true
20 window.location.assign('/login')
21}
22
23http.interceptors.request.use(
24 (config) => {
25 const token = localStorage.getItem('nw_token')
26 if (token) {
27 config.headers = config.headers || {}
28 config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
29 }
30 return config
31 },
32 (error) => Promise.reject(error)
33)
34
35http.interceptors.response.use(
36 (response) => {
37 const body = response.data
38 if (body && typeof body === 'object' && typeof body.code !== 'undefined') {
39 if (body.code === 0) {
40 return body.data
41 }
42 const error = new Error(body.message || '请求失败，请稍后重试')
43 error.code = body.code
44 error.status = response.status
45 if (body.code === 401) {
46 redirectToLogin()
47 }
48 return Promise.reject(error)
49 }
50 return body
51 },
52 (error) => {
53 if (error.response) {
54 const body = error.response.data
55 const code =
56 body && typeof body.code !== 'undefined' ? body.code : error.response.status
57 const message =
58 (body && body.message) || `请求失败（HTTP ${error.response.status}）`
59 const wrapped = new Error(message)
60 wrapped.code = code
61 wrapped.status = error.response.status
62 if (code === 401 || error.response.status === 401) {
63 redirectToLogin()
64 }
65 return Promise.reject(wrapped)
66 }
67 if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED') {
68 const timeoutError = new Error('请求超时，请稍后重试')
69 timeoutError.code = 'TIMEOUT'
70 return Promise.reject(timeoutError)
71 }
72 const networkError = new Error('网络异常，请确认后端服务已启动')
73 networkError.code = 'NETWORK'
74 return Promise.reject(networkError)
75 }
76)
77
78export function uploadFile(file) {
79 const formData = new FormData()
80 formData.append('file', file)
81 return http.post('/api/files/upload', formData)
82}
83
84export default http

1import { reactive } from 'vue'
2import api from '@/api'
3
4function readStoredUser() {
5 try {
6 const raw = localStorage.getItem('nw_user')
7 return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null
8 } catch (error) {
9 localStorage.removeItem('nw_user')
10 return null
11 }
12}
13
14function sanitizeUser(user) {
15 if (!user) return null
16 const copy = { ...user }
17 delete copy.password
18 return copy
19}
20
21const state = reactive({
22 token: localStorage.getItem('nw_token') || '',
23 user: sanitizeUser(readStoredUser())
24})
25
26function persist(token, user) {
27 state.token = token || ''
28 state.user = sanitizeUser(user)
29 if (state.token) {
30 localStorage.setItem('nw_token', state.token)
31 } else {
32 localStorage.removeItem('nw_token')
33 }
34 if (state.user) {
35 localStorage.setItem('nw_user', JSON.stringify(state.user))
36 } else {
37 localStorage.removeItem('nw_user')
38 }
39}
40
41function isLoggedIn() {
42 return Boolean(state.token && state.user)
43}
44
45function isAdmin() {
46 return Boolean(state.user && state.user.role === 'ADMIN')
47}
48
49async function login(username, password) {
50 const data = await api.post('/api/auth/login', { username, password })
51 if (!data || !data.token) {
52 throw new Error('登录响应异常，请稍后重试')
53 }
54 persist(data.token, data.user)
55 return state.user
56}
57
58function logout() {
59 persist('', null)
60}
61
62function setUser(user) {
63 state.user = sanitizeUser(user)
64 if (state.user) {
65 localStorage.setItem('nw_user', JSON.stringify(state.user))
66 } else {
67 localStorage.removeItem('nw_user')
68 }
69}
70
71async function bootstrap() {
72 if (!state.token) return
73 try {
74 const user = await api.get('/api/users/me')
75 if (user) setUser(user)
76 } catch (error) {
77 // 401 已由 axios 拦截器统一清除登录态并跳转；其他错误保留本地登录态。
78 }
79}
80
81export default {
82 state,
83 login,
84 logout,
85 setUser,
86 isLoggedIn,
87 isAdmin,
88 bootstrap
89}

toast.js frontend/src/store/toast.js 32 行 VS Code 打开
1import { reactive } from 'vue'
2
3export const toasts = reactive([])
4
5let seed = 0
6
7export function notify(message, type = 'info', duration = 3200) {
8 const id = ++seed
9 toasts.push({ id, message: String(message || ''), type })
10 if (duration > 0) {
11 window.setTimeout(() => removeToast(id), duration)
12 }
13 return id
14}
15
16export function notifySuccess(message) {
17 return notify(message, 'success')
18}
19
20export function notifyError(error) {
21 const message =
22 typeof error === 'string'
23 ? error
24 : (error && error.message) || '操作失败，请稍后重试'
25 return notify(message, 'error', 4200)
26}
27
28export function removeToast(id) {
29 const index = toasts.findIndex((item) => item.id === id)
30 if (index !== -1) toasts.splice(index, 1)
31}

5const routes = [
6 {
7 path: '/',

10 meta: { title: '首页' }
11 },
12 {
13 path: '/login',

15 component: () => import('@/views/LoginView.vue'),
16 meta: { title: '登录', guestOnly: true }
17 },
18 {
19 path: '/register',
20 name: 'register',
21 component: () => import('@/views/RegisterView.vue'),
22 meta: { title: '注册', guestOnly: true }
23 },
24 {
25 path: '/notes/new',
26 name: 'note-new',
27 component: () => import('@/views/NoteEditorView.vue'),
28 meta: { title: '发布笔记', requiresAuth: true }
29 },
30 {
31 path: '/notes/:id/edit',
32 name: 'note-edit',
33 component: () => import('@/views/NoteEditorView.vue'),
34 meta: { title: '编辑笔记', requiresAuth: true }
35 },
36 {
37 path: '/notes/:id',
38 name: 'note-detail',
39 component: () => import('@/views/NoteDetailView.vue'),
40 meta: { title: '笔记详情' }
41 },
42 {
43 path: '/me',
44 name: 'my-notes',
45 component: () => import('@/views/MyNotesView.vue'),
46 meta: { title: '我的笔记', requiresAuth: true }
47 },
48 {
49 path: '/profile',
50 name: 'profile',
51 component: () => import('@/views/ProfileView.vue'),
52 meta: { title: '个人资料', requiresAuth: true }
53 },
54 {
55 path: '/users/:id',
56 name: 'user-profile',
57 component: () => import('@/views/UserProfileView.vue'),
58 meta: { title: '作者主页' }
59 },
60 {
61 path: '/ai',
62 name: 'ai',
63 component: () => import('@/views/AiView.vue'),
64 meta: { title: 'AI 助手', requiresAuth: true }
65 },
66 {
67 path: '/admin',
68 name: 'admin',
69 component: () => import('@/views/AdminView.vue'),
70 meta: { title: '管理后台', requiresAuth: true, admin: true }
71 },
72 {
73 path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*',
74 name: 'not-found',
75 component: () => import('@/views/NotFoundView.vue'),
76 meta: { title: '页面不存在' }
77 }
78]
79
80const router = createRouter({
81 history: createWebHistory(process.env.BASE_URL),
82 routes,
83 scrollBehavior(to, from, savedPosition) {
84 if (savedPosition) return savedPosition
85 return { top: 0 }
86 }
87})
88
89router.beforeEach((to) => {
90 document.title = to.meta.title ? `${to.meta.title} · 笔记工坊` : '笔记工坊'
91
92 if (to.meta.guestOnly && auth.isLoggedIn()) {
93 return { name: 'home' }
94 }
95
96 if (to.meta.requiresAuth && !auth.isLoggedIn()) {
97 return { name: 'login', query: { redirect: to.fullPath } }
98 }
99
100 if (to.meta.admin && !auth.isAdmin()) {
101 notify('无权访问管理后台，仅管理员可进入', 'error')
102 return { name: 'home' }
103 }
104
105 return true
106})
107
108export default router

172 @click="saveResult"
173 >
174 <span v-if="savingResult" class="spinner"></span>
175 {{ result.saved ? '已保存到笔记' : savingResult ? '保存中…' : '保存到笔记' }}
176 </button>
177 <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" @click="copyResult">复制内容</button>
178 </div>
179 </div>
180
181 <EmptyState
182 v-else
183 icon="✦"
184 title="还没有生成内容"
185 description="在左侧选择笔记和生成类型，点击「生成 AI 内容」开始。"
186 />
187 </div>
188 </section>
189
190 <!-- 智能客服 -->
191 <section v-else-if="activeTab === 'chat'" class="ai-chat-layout">
192 <aside class="card chat-sessions">
193 <div class="chat-sessions__head">
194 <h2>会话列表</h2>
195 <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" @click="newSession">＋ 新建</button>
196 </div>
197
198 <div v-if="sessionsLoading" class="chat-sessions__loading">
199 <div v-for="index in 3" :key="index" class="skeleton chat-sessions__skeleton"></div>
200 </div>
201
202 <div v-else-if="sessionsError" class="alert alert-error chat-sessions__error">
203 <span class="alert__icon">!</span>
204 <span>{{ sessionsError }}</span>
205 <button type="button" class="link" @click="loadSessions">重试</button>
206 </div>
207
208 <ul v-else-if="sessions.length" class="session-list">
209 <li v-for="session in sessions" :key="session.id" class="session-item">
210 <button
211 type="button"
212 class="session-item__main"
213 :class="{ 'is-active': session.id === currentSessionId }"
214 @click="openSession(session)"
215 >
216 <span class="session-item__title">{{ session.title || `会话 #${session.id}` }}</span>
217 <small>{{ formatDate(session.updatedAt) }}</small>
218 </button>
219 <button
220 type="button"
221 class="session-item__delete"
222 title="删除会话"
223 aria-label="删除会话"
224 @click="removeSession(session)"
225 >
226 ×
227 </button>
228 </li>
229 </ul>
230
231 <div v-else class="chat-sessions__empty">
232 <span class="chat-sessions__empty-icon">💬</span>
233 <p>还没有会话</p>
234 <small>点击「新建」或直接发送消息，开始和 AI 对话。</small>
235 </div>
236 </aside>
237
238 <div class="card chat-panel">
239 <div class="chat-panel__head">
240 <div>
241 <h2>{{ currentSession ? currentSession.title : '新会话' }}</h2>
242 <p>{{ currentSession ? `会话 #${currentSession.id}` : '发送第一条消息后会自动创建会话' }}</p>
243 </div>
244 <button
245 v-if="currentSession"
246 type="button"
247 class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm"
248 :disabled="sending"
249 @click="removeSession(currentSession)"
250 >
251 删除会话
252 </button>
253 </div>
254
255 <div ref="chatBody" class="chat-messages">
256 <div v-if="messagesLoading" class="chat-loading">
257 <div v-for="index in 3" :key="index" class="skeleton chat-loading__line"></div>
258 </div>
259
260 <template v-else>
261 <div v-if="!messages.length" class="chat-welcome">
262 <span class="chat-welcome__icon">AI</span>
263 <h3>有什么可以帮你？</h3>
264 <p>可以问我关于笔记发布、审核、AI 功能或社区使用的问题。</p>
265 <div class="chat-welcome__suggestions">
266 <button
267 v-for="question in suggestedQuestions"
268 :key="question"
269 type="button"
270 @click="quickAsk(question)"
271 >
272 {{ question }}
273 </button>
274 </div>
275 </div>
276
277 <div
278 v-for="(message, index) in messages"
279 :key="message.id || `message-${index}`"
280 class="chat-message"
281 :class="`chat-message--${message.role}`"
282 >
283 <UserAvatar
284 v-if="message.role === 'user'"
285 :src="currentUser.avatar"
286 :name="currentUser.nickname || currentUser.username"
287 :size="32"
288 />
289 <span v-else class="ai-avatar">AI</span>
290 <div class="chat-bubble">
291 <p>{{ message.content }}</p>
292 <time>{{ timeAgo(message.createdAt) }}</time>
293 </div>
294 </div>
295
296 <div v-if="sending" class="chat-message chat-message--assistant">
297 <span class="ai-avatar">AI</span>
298 <div class="chat-bubble chat-bubble--typing" aria-label="AI 正在回复">
299 <span></span><span></span><span></span>
300 </div>
301 </div>
302 </template>
303 </div>
304
305 <div v-if="chatError" class="alert alert-warning chat-error">
306 <span class="alert__icon">!</span>
307 <span>{{ chatError }}</span>
308 </div>
309
310 <form class="chat-input" @submit.prevent="sendMessage">
311 <textarea
312 v-model="chatInput"
313 class="textarea chat-input__field"
314 maxlength="2000"
315 placeholder="输入你的问题，Enter 发送，Shift + Enter 换行…"
316 :disabled="sending"
317 @keydown.enter.exact.prevent="sendMessage"
318 ></textarea>
319 <div class="chat-input__foot">
320 <span class="form-hint">{{ chatInput.length }}/2000</span>
321 <button
322 type="submit"
323 class="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
324 :disabled="sending || !chatInput.trim()"
325 >
326 <span v-if="sending" class="spinner"></span>
327 {{ sending ? '回复中…' : '发送' }}
328 </button>
329 </div>
330 </form>
331 <p class="chat-panel__hint">AI 可能会犯错，重要信息请自行核实。</p>
332 </div>
333 </section>
334
335 <!-- AI 状态 -->
336 <section v-else class="ai-status-page">
337 <div class="ai-status-grid">
338 <div class="card ai-status-card">
339 <span class="ai-status-card__label">AI 服务状态</span>
340 <div class="ai-status-card__value" :class="statusPillClass">
341 <span class="ai-status-pill__dot"></span>
342 {{ statusLabel }}
343 </div>
344 <p>状态来自后端 <code>/api/ai/status</code> 接口。</p>
345 <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" @click="loadAiStatus">
346 重新检测
347 </button>
348 </div>
349
350 <div class="card ai-status-card">
351 <span class="ai-status-card__label">支持场景</span>
352 <div class="scene-chips">
353 <span v-for="scene in scenes" :key="scene" class="scene-chip">{{ scene }}</span>
354 </div>
355 <p>阅读辅助（总结 / 人群 / 评分）与智能客服会话。</p>
356 </div>
357 </div>
358
359 <div class="card ai-config-card">
360 <h2>配置说明</h2>
361 <p>AI 功能需要后端配置以下环境变量后重启服务：</p>
362 <pre class="ai-config-code">AI_API_KEY=sk-...
363AI_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com
364AI_MODEL=deepseek-chat
365AI_ENABLED=true</pre>
366 <p class="ai-config-hint">
367 未配置时，生成与客服接口会返回 503。本页面会提示「AI 未配置，请设置 AI_API_KEY」，不会白屏。
368 </p>
369
370 <div v-if="statusNote" class="alert alert-info">
371 <span class="alert__icon">i</span>
372 <span>后端提示：{{ statusNote }}</span>
373 </div>
374 <div v-if="statusError" class="alert alert-error">
375 <span class="alert__icon">!</span>
376 <span>{{ statusError }}</span>
377 </div>
378 </div>
379 </section>
380 </div>
381</template>
382
383<script>
384import { computed, nextTick, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
385import api from '@/api'
386import auth from '@/store/auth'
387import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
388import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
389import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
390import { aiTypeLabel, formatDate, timeAgo } from '@/utils/format'
391
392const AI_TYPES = [
393 { value: 'SUMMARY', label: '内容总结', icon: '✦', desc: '提炼笔记的核心观点与要点' },
394 { value: 'AUDIENCE', label: '适合人群', icon: '◎', desc: '推荐 3 类最适合阅读的人群' },
395 { value: 'SCORE', label: '质量评分', icon: '★', desc: '从三个维度评分并给出建议' }
396]
397
398const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
399 '怎么发表一篇公开笔记？',
400 '公开笔记审核需要多久？',
401 '如何让笔记更容易被推荐？'
402]
403
404export default {
405 name: 'AiView',
406 components: { UserAvatar, EmptyState },
407 setup() {
408 const activeTab = ref('read')
409 const currentUser = computed(() => auth.state.user || {})
410
411 const aiStatus = ref(null)
412 const statusLoading = ref(false)
413 const statusError = ref('')
414 const aiUnavailable = ref(false)
415 const aiUnavailableMessage = ref('')
416
417 const myNotes = ref([])
418 const notesLoading = ref(true)
419 const notesError = ref('')
420 const selectedNoteId = ref(null)
421 const selectedType = ref('SUMMARY')
422 const existingAi = ref(null)
423 const generating = ref(false)
424 const result = ref(null)
425 const readError = ref('')
426 const savingResult = ref(false)
427
428 const sessions = ref([])
429 const sessionsLoading = ref(false)
430 const sessionsError = ref('')
431 const sessionsLoaded = ref(false)
432 const currentSessionId = ref(null)
433 const messages = ref([])
434 const messagesLoading = ref(false)
435 const chatInput = ref('')
436 const sending = ref(false)
437 const chatError = ref('')
438 const chatBody = ref(null)
439
440 const aiTypes = AI_TYPES
441 const suggestedQuestions = SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS
442
443 const statusPillClass = computed(() => {
444 if (statusLoading.value) return 'is-unknown'
445 if (aiUnavailable.value) return 'is-disabled'
446 if (!aiStatus.value) return 'is-unknown'
447 return aiStatus.value.enabled ? 'is-enabled' : 'is-disabled'
448 })
449
450 const statusLabel = computed(() => {
451 if (statusLoading.value) return '检测中…'
452 if (aiUnavailable.value) return 'AI 不可用'
453 if (!aiStatus.value) return '状态未知'
454 return aiStatus.value.enabled ? 'AI 已启用' : 'AI 未启用'
455 })
456
457 const scenes = computed(() => {
458 if (aiStatus.value && Array.isArray(aiStatus.value.scenes)) {
459 return aiStatus.value.scenes
460 }
461 return ['SUMMARY', 'AUDIENCE', 'SCORE', 'CHAT']
462 })
463
464 const statusNote = computed(() => (aiStatus.value && aiStatus.value.note) || '')
465
466 const showBanner = computed(
467 () => aiUnavailable.value || Boolean(aiStatus.value && aiStatus.value.enabled === false)
468 )
469
470 const bannerDetail = computed(() => {
471 if (aiUnavailableMessage.value) return aiUnavailableMessage.value
472 if (aiStatus.value && aiStatus.value.note) return aiStatus.value.note
473 return '请在后端设置环境变量 AI_API_KEY 后重启服务，再回来重试。'
474 })
475
476 const currentSession = computed(
477 () => sessions.value.find((item) => item.id === currentSessionId.value) || null
478 )
479
480 async function loadAiStatus() {
481 statusLoading.value = true
482 statusError.value = ''
483 try {
484 aiStatus.value = await api.get('/api/ai/status')
485 if (aiStatus.value && aiStatus.value.enabled) {
486 aiUnavailable.value = false
487 aiUnavailableMessage.value = ''
488 }
489 } catch (err) {
490 statusError.value = err.message || 'AI 状态加载失败'
491 } finally {
492 statusLoading.value = false
493 }
494 }
495
496 async function loadMyNotes() {
497 notesLoading.value = true
498 notesError.value = ''
499 try {
500 const data = await api.get('/api/notes/mine', { params: { page: 1, size: 100 } })
501 myNotes.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
502 if (myNotes.value.length) {
503 const stillExists = myNotes.value.some((note) => note.id === selectedNoteId.value)
504 if (!stillExists) {
505 selectedNoteId.value = myNotes.value[0].id
506 }
507 await loadExistingAi()
508 } else {
509 selectedNoteId.value = null
510 existingAi.value = null
511 }
512 } catch (err) {
513 notesError.value = err.message || '我的笔记加载失败'
514 notifyError(err)
515 } finally {
516 notesLoading.value = false
517 }
518 }
519
520 async function loadExistingAi() {
521 if (!selectedNoteId.value) {
522 existingAi.value = null
523 return
524 }
525 try {
526 const data = await api.get(`/api/ai/notes/${selectedNoteId.value}`)
527 existingAi.value = data && data.content ? data : null
528 } catch (err) {
529 existingAi.value = null
530 }
531 }
532
533 watch(selectedNoteId, async () => {
534 result.value = null
535 readError.value = ''
536 await loadExistingAi()
537 })
538
539 function chooseType(type) {
540 selectedType.value = type
541 result.value = null
542 readError.value = ''
543 }
544
545 function friendlyAiError(err) {
546 const message = (err && err.message) || 'AI 服务暂不可用，请稍后重试'
547 const unavailable =
548 (err && err.code === 503) ||
549 /AI 未配置|AI 服务|AI 功能未启用|API_KEY|未配置/i.test(message)
550 if (unavailable) {
551 aiUnavailable.value = true
552 aiUnavailableMessage.value =
553 '后端 AI 服务暂不可用，请检查 AI_API_KEY、AI_BASE_URL 与 AI_MODEL 配置后重启服务。'
554 return 'AI 未配置，请设置 AI_API_KEY 后重试。'
555 }
556 return message
557 }
558
559 async function generate() {
560 if (!selectedNoteId.value) {
561 notifyError('请先选择一篇笔记')
562 return
563 }
564 generating.value = true
565 readError.value = ''
566 result.value = null
567 try {
568 const data = await api.post(`/api/ai/notes/${selectedNoteId.value}/generate`, {
569 type: selectedType.value
570 })
571 result.value = data
572 aiUnavailable.value = false
573 notifySuccess('AI 内容生成完成')
574 } catch (err) {
575 readError.value = friendlyAiError(err)
576 notifyError(err)
577 } finally {
578 generating.value = false
579 }
580 }
581
582 async function saveResult() {
583 if (!result.value || !selectedNoteId.value) return
584 savingResult.value = true
585 try {
586 const data = await api.post(`/api/ai/notes/${selectedNoteId.value}/save`, {
587 type: result.value.type,
588 content: result.value.content
589 })
590 result.value.saved = true
591 existingAi.value = { type: data.type, content: data.content }
592 notifySuccess('已保存到笔记，详情页将展示 AI 辅助区块')
593 } catch (err) {
594 notifyError(err)
595 } finally {
596 savingResult.value = false
597 }
598 }
599
600 async function copyResult() {
601 if (!result.value) return
602 try {
603 await navigator.clipboard.writeText(result.value.content)
604 notifySuccess('已复制到剪贴板')
605 } catch (err) {
606 notifyError('复制失败，请手动选择文本复制')
607 }
608 }
609
610 function switchTab(tab) {
611 activeTab.value = tab
612 if (tab === 'chat' && !sessionsLoaded.value) {
613 loadSessions()
614 }
615 if (tab === 'chat') {
616 scrollChat()
617 }
618 }
619
620 async function loadSessions() {
621 sessionsLoading.value = true
622 sessionsError.value = ''
623 try {
624 const data = await api.get('/api/ai/sessions')
625 sessions.value = Array.isArray(data) ? data : []
626 sessionsLoaded.value = true
627 } catch (err) {
628 sessionsError.value = err.message || '会话列表加载失败'
629 } finally {
630 sessionsLoading.value = false
631 }
632 }
633
634 function newSession() {
635 if (sending.value) {
636 notifyError('请等待当前回复完成')
637 return
638 }
639 currentSessionId.value = null
640 messages.value = []
641 chatInput.value = ''
642 chatError.value = ''
643 scrollChat()
644 }
645
646 async function openSession(session) {
647 if (sending.value) {
648 notifyError('请等待当前回复完成')
649 return
650 }
651 currentSessionId.value = session.id
652 chatError.value = ''
653 messagesLoading.value = true
654 try {
655 const data = await api.get(`/api/ai/sessions/${session.id}/messages`)
656 messages.value = Array.isArray(data) ? data : []
657 scrollChat()
658 } catch (err) {
659 chatError.value = err.message || '会话记录加载失败'
660 messages.value = []
661 } finally {
662 messagesLoading.value = false
663 }
664 }
665
666 async function removeSession(session) {
667 if (!session) return
668 if (sending.value) {
669 notifyError('请等待当前回复完成')
670 return
671 }
672 if (!window.confirm(`确定删除会话「${session.title || `会话 #${session.id}`}」吗？`)) return
673 try {
674 await api.delete(`/api/ai/sessions/${session.id}`)
675 if (currentSessionId.value === session.id) {
676 currentSessionId.value = null
677 messages.value = []
678 }
679 notifySuccess('会话已删除')
680 await loadSessions()
681 } catch (err) {
682 notifyError(err)
683 }
684 }
685
686 function quickAsk(question) {
687 chatInput.value = question
688 sendMessage()
689 }
690
691 async function sendMessage() {
692 const text = chatInput.value.trim()
693 if (!text || sending.value) return
694 if (text.length > 2000) {
695 notifyError('消息不能超过 2000 个字符')
696 return
697 }
698
699 const sessionId = currentSessionId.value
700 messages.value.push({
701 id: `temp-user-${Date.now()}`,
702 role: 'user',
703 content: text,
704 createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
705 })
706 chatInput.value = ''
707 chatError.value = ''
708 sending.value = true
709 scrollChat()
710
711 try {
712 const data = await api.post('/api/ai/chat', { sessionId, message: text })
713 currentSessionId.value = data.sessionId
714 messages.value.push({
715 id: `assistant-${Date.now()}`,
716 role: 'assistant',
717 content: data.reply,
718 createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
719 })
720 aiUnavailable.value = false
721 sessionsLoaded.value = false
722 await loadSessions()
723 } catch (err) {
724 chatError.value = friendlyAiError(err)
725 notifyError(err)
726 sessionsLoaded.value = false
727 loadSessions()
728 } finally {
729 sending.value = false
730 scrollChat()
731 }
732 }
733
734 function scrollChat() {
735 nextTick(() => {
736 const element = chatBody.value
737 if (element) element.scrollTop = element.scrollHeight
738 })
739 }
740
741 onMounted(() => {
742 loadAiStatus()
743 loadMyNotes()
744 })
745
746 return {
747 activeTab,
748 currentUser,
749 aiStatus,
750 statusLoading,
751 statusError,
752 aiUnavailable,
753 aiUnavailableMessage,
754 myNotes,
755 notesLoading,
756 notesError,
757 selectedNoteId,
758 selectedType,
759 existingAi,
760 generating,
761 result,
762 readError,
763 savingResult,
764 sessions,
765 sessionsLoading,
766 sessionsError,
767 currentSessionId,
768 messages,
769 messagesLoading,
770 chatInput,
771 sending,
772 chatError,
773 chatBody,
774 aiTypes,
775 suggestedQuestions,
776 statusPillClass,
777 statusLabel,
778 scenes,
779 statusNote,
780 showBanner,
781 bannerDetail,
782 currentSession,
783 loadAiStatus,
784 loadMyNotes,
785 chooseType,
786 generate,
787 saveResult,
788 copyResult,
789 switchTab,
790 loadSessions,
791 newSession,
792 openSession,
793 removeSession,
794 quickAsk,
795 sendMessage,
796 aiTypeLabel,
797 formatDate,
798 timeAgo
799 }
800 }
801}
802</script>
803

923.ai-panel__head h2,

929.ai-panel__head p,

185<script>
186import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
187import api from '@/api'
188import auth from '@/store/auth'
189import { notifyError } from '@/store/toast'
190import NoteCard from '@/components/NoteCard.vue'
191import AppPagination from '@/components/AppPagination.vue'
192import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
193import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
194import { hydrateNoteCovers } from '@/utils/hydrate'
195
196const PAGE_SIZE = 9
197
198export default {
199 name: 'HomeView',
200 components: { NoteCard, AppPagination, EmptyState, UserAvatar },
201 setup() {
202 const notes = ref([])
203 const total = ref(0)
204 const page = ref(1)
205 const sort = ref('latest')
206 const loading = ref(true)
207 const error = ref('')
208
209 const authors = ref([])
210 const authorsLoading = ref(true)
211 const authorsError = ref('')
212
213 const loggedIn = computed(() => auth.isLoggedIn())
214 const size = PAGE_SIZE
215 let requestSeed = 0
216
217 async function loadNotes() {
218 const seed = ++requestSeed
219 loading.value = true
220 error.value = ''
221 try {
222 const data = await api.get('/api/public/notes', {
223 params: { page: page.value, size: PAGE_SIZE, sort: sort.value }
224 })
225 if (seed !== requestSeed) return
226 notes.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
227 total.value = Number(data.total) || 0
228 hydrateNoteCovers(notes.value, () => seed !== requestSeed)
229 } catch (err) {
230 if (seed !== requestSeed) return
231 error.value = err.message || '笔记列表加载失败'
232 notes.value = []
233 total.value = 0
234 notifyError(err)
235 } finally {
236 if (seed === requestSeed) loading.value = false
237 }
238 }
239
240 async function loadAuthors() {
241 authorsLoading.value = true
242 authorsError.value = ''
243 try {
244 const data = await api.get('/api/public/authors/hot', { params: { limit: 6 } })
245 authors.value = Array.isArray(data) ? data : []
246 } catch (err) {
247 authorsError.value = err.message || '热门作者加载失败'
248 } finally {
249 authorsLoading.value = false
250 }
251 }
252
253 function changeSort(next) {
254 if (sort.value === next) return
255 sort.value = next
256 page.value = 1
257 loadNotes()
258 }
259
260 function changePage(next) {
261 page.value = next
262 loadNotes()
263 const feed = document.getElementById('feed')
264 if (feed) feed.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
265 }
266
267 onMounted(() => {
268 loadNotes()
269 loadAuthors()
270 })
271
272 return {
273 notes,
274 total,
275 page,
276 size,
277 sort,
278 loading,
279 error,
280 authors,
281 authorsLoading,
282 authorsError,
283 loggedIn,
284 loadNotes,
285 loadAuthors,
286 changeSort,
287 changePage
288 }
289 }
290}
291</script>

81<script>
82import { computed, onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue'
83import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
84import AuthShell from '@/components/AuthShell.vue'
85import auth from '@/store/auth'
86import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
87import { displayName } from '@/utils/format'
88
89export default {
90 name: 'LoginView',
91 components: { AuthShell },
92 setup() {
93 const route = useRoute()
94 const router = useRouter()
95 const form = reactive({ username: '', password: '' })
96 const loading = ref(false)
97 const error = ref('')
98 const showPassword = ref(false)
99 const registered = computed(() => route.query.registered === '1')
100
101 onMounted(() => {
102 if (typeof route.query.username === 'string') {
103 form.username = route.query.username
104 }
105 if (route.query.registered === '1') {
106 notifySuccess('注册成功，请登录')
107 }
108 })
109
110 function fillDemo(username, password) {
111 form.username = username
112 form.password = password
113 error.value = ''
114 }
115
116 function resolveRedirect() {
117 const redirect = route.query.redirect
118 if (typeof redirect !== 'string' || !redirect.startsWith('/')) return '/'
119 if (redirect.startsWith('/login') || redirect.startsWith('/register')) return '/'
120 return redirect
121 }
122
123 async function submit() {
124 error.value = ''
125 if (!form.username.trim()) {
126 error.value = '请输入用户名'
127 return
128 }
129 if (!form.password) {
130 error.value = '请输入密码'
131 return
132 }
133 loading.value = true
134 try {
135 await auth.login(form.username.trim(), form.password)
136 notifySuccess(`欢迎回来，${displayName(auth.state.user)}`)
137 router.replace(resolveRedirect())
138 } catch (err) {
139 error.value = err.message || '登录失败'
140 notifyError(err)
141 } finally {
142 loading.value = false
143 }
144 }
145
146 return { form, loading, error, showPassword, registered, submit, fillDemo }
147 }
148}
149</script>

99<script>
100import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
101import api from '@/api'
102import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
103import AppPagination from '@/components/AppPagination.vue'
104import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
105import { excerpt, formatDate, noteStatusMeta } from '@/utils/format'
106
107const PAGE_SIZE = 8
108
109export default {
110 name: 'MyNotesView',
111 components: { AppPagination, EmptyState },
112 setup() {
113 const notes = ref([])
114 const total = ref(0)
115 const page = ref(1)
116 const loading = ref(true)
117 const error = ref('')
118 const deletingId = ref(null)
119 const size = PAGE_SIZE
120 let requestSeed = 0
121
122 async function loadNotes() {
123 const seed = ++requestSeed
124 loading.value = true
125 error.value = ''
126 try {
127 const data = await api.get('/api/notes/mine', {
128 params: { page: page.value, size: PAGE_SIZE }
129 })
130 if (seed !== requestSeed) return
131 notes.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
132 total.value = Number(data.total) || 0
133 const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total.value / PAGE_SIZE))
134 if (page.value > totalPages) {
135 page.value = totalPages
136 loadNotes()
137 }
138 } catch (err) {
139 if (seed !== requestSeed) return
140 error.value = err.message || '我的笔记加载失败'
141 notes.value = []
142 total.value = 0
143 notifyError(err)
144 } finally {
145 if (seed === requestSeed) loading.value = false
146 }
147 }
148
149 function changePage(next) {
150 page.value = next
151 loadNotes()
152 window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
153 }
154
155 async function removeNote(note) {
156 if (!note) return
157 if (!window.confirm(`确定删除《${note.title || '无标题笔记'}》吗？删除后无法恢复。`)) return
158 deletingId.value = note.id
159 try {
160 await api.delete(`/api/notes/${note.id}`)
161 notifySuccess('笔记已删除')
162 if (notes.value.length === 1 && page.value > 1) {
163 page.value -= 1
164 }
165 await loadNotes()
166 } catch (err) {
167 notifyError(err)
168 } finally {
169 deletingId.value = null
170 }
171 }
172
173 onMounted(loadNotes)
174
175 return {
176 notes,
177 total,
178 page,
179 size,
180 loading,
181 error,
182 deletingId,
183 loadNotes,
184 changePage,
185 removeNote,
186 excerpt,
187 formatDate,
188 statusMeta: noteStatusMeta
189 }
190 }
191}
192</script>
