267 <button
268 v-if="canDelete(child)"
269 type="button"
270 class="comment__op comment__op--danger"
271 @click="removeComment(child)"
272 >
273 删除
274 </button>
275 </span>
276 </div>
277 <p class="comment__content">{{ child.content }}</p>
278
279 <div v-if="isReplyingChild(root, child)" class="reply-form">
280 <textarea
281 v-model="replyContent"
282 class="textarea reply-form__input"
283 maxlength="500"
284 :placeholder="`回复 @${child.nickname}…`"
285 ></textarea>
286 <div class="reply-form__foot">
287 <span class="form-hint">{{ replyContent.length }}/500</span>
288 <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" @click="cancelReply">取消</button>
289 <button
290 type="button"
291 class="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
292 :disabled="submittingReply || !replyContent.trim()"
293 @click="submitReply(root)"
294 >
295 <span v-if="submittingReply" class="spinner"></span>
296 {{ submittingReply ? '发送中…' : '回复' }}
297 </button>
298 </div>
299 </div>
300 </div>
301 </div>
302 </div>
303 </div>
304 </div>
305 </div>
306
307 <EmptyState
308 v-else
309 icon="💬"
310 title="还没有评论"
311 description="来写下第一条评论，和作者交流读书心得吧。"
312 />
313 </template>
314
315 <div v-else class="alert alert-info">
316 <span class="alert__icon">i</span>
317 <span>只有审核通过且公开的笔记才开放评论。</span>
318 </div>
319 </section>
320 </article>
321
322 <aside class="detail-side">
323 <div class="card detail-author-card">
324 <UserAvatar :src="note.authorAvatar" :name="note.authorName" :size="68" />
325 <h3>{{ note.authorName || '匿名作者' }}</h3>
326 <p v-if="author && author.bio" class="detail-author-card__bio">{{ author.bio }}</p>
327 <p v-else class="detail-author-card__bio">这个作者还没有填写简介。</p>
328
329 <div v-if="author" class="detail-author-card__stats">
330 <div>
331 <strong>{{ author.fansCount || 0 }}</strong>
332 <span>粉丝</span>
333 </div>
334 <div>
335 <strong>{{ author.noteCount || 0 }}</strong>
336 <span>公开笔记</span>
337 </div>
338 </div>
339
340 <RouterLink
341 v-if="note.userId"
342 :to="`/users/${note.userId}`"
343 class="btn btn-outline btn-block detail-author-card__btn"
344 >
345 查看作者主页
346 </RouterLink>
347 </div>
348
349 <div class="card detail-info-card">
350 <h3>笔记信息</h3>
351 <dl class="detail-info-list">
352 <div>
353 <dt>所属书籍</dt>
354 <dd>{{ note.bookName || '未分类' }}</dd>
355 </div>
356 <div>
357 <dt>可见性</dt>
358 <dd>{{ note.isPublic === 1 ? '公开' : '仅自己可见' }}</dd>
359 </div>
360 <div>
361 <dt>状态</dt>
362 <dd>{{ statusMeta.label }}</dd>
363 </div>
364 <div>
365 <dt>发布时间</dt>
366 <dd>{{ formatDate(note.createdAt) }}</dd>
367 </div>
368 <div v-if="note.updatedAt && note.updatedAt !== note.createdAt">
369 <dt>更新时间</dt>
370 <dd>{{ formatDate(note.updatedAt) }}</dd>
371 </div>
372 </dl>
373 </div>
374 </aside>
375 </div>
376
377 <Transition name="fade">
378 <div
379 v-if="lightboxIndex !== null && images.length"
380 class="lightbox"
381 role="dialog"
382 aria-label="查看配图"
383 @click.self="closeLightbox"
384 >
385 <button type="button" class="lightbox__close" aria-label="关闭" @click="closeLightbox">×</button>
386 <button
387 v-if="images.length > 1"
388 type="button"
389 class="lightbox__nav lightbox__nav--prev"
390 aria-label="上一张"
391 @click.stop="stepLightbox(-1)"
392 >
393 ‹
394 </button>
395 <img class="lightbox__image" :src="mediaUrl(images[lightboxIndex])" alt="笔记配图" />
396 <button
397 v-if="images.length > 1"
398 type="button"
399 class="lightbox__nav lightbox__nav--next"
400 aria-label="下一张"
401 @click.stop="stepLightbox(1)"
402 >
403 ›
404 </button>
405 <span class="lightbox__counter">{{ lightboxIndex + 1 }} / {{ images.length }}</span>
406 </div>
407 </Transition>
408 </div>
409</template>
410
411<script>
412import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
413import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
414import api from '@/api'
415import auth from '@/store/auth'
416import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
417import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
418import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
419import {
420 aiTypeLabel,
421 countComments,
422 flattenReplies,
423 formatDate,
424 mediaUrl,
425 noteStatusMeta,
426 timeAgo
427} from '@/utils/format'
428
429export default {
430 name: 'NoteDetailView',
431 components: { UserAvatar, EmptyState },
432 setup() {
433 const route = useRoute()
434 const router = useRouter()
435
436 const detail = ref(null)
437 const loading = ref(true)
438 const error = ref('')
439 const author = ref(null)
440 const deleting = ref(false)
441 const liking = ref(false)
442
443 const comments = ref([])
444 const commentsLoading = ref(false)
445 const commentsError = ref('')
446 const commentContent = ref('')
447 const submittingComment = ref(false)
448
449 const replyTo = ref(null)
450 const replyContent = ref('')
451 const submittingReply = ref(false)
452
453 const lightboxIndex = ref(null)
454
455 const note = computed(() => (detail.value && detail.value.note) || {})
456 const images = computed(() =>
457 detail.value && Array.isArray(detail.value.images) ? detail.value.images : []
458 )
459 const liked = computed(() => Boolean(detail.value && detail.value.liked))
460 const loggedIn = computed(() => auth.isLoggedIn())
461 const currentUser = computed(() => auth.state.user || {})
462 const owner = computed(
463 () => Boolean(currentUser.value.id && note.value.userId === currentUser.value.id)
464 )
465 const canComment = computed(() => note.value.isPublic === 1 && note.value.status === 1)
466 const canLike = computed(() => canComment.value)
467 const statusMeta = computed(() => noteStatusMeta(note.value.status))
468 const commentTotal = computed(() => countComments(comments.value))
469 const commentTree = computed(() =>
470 comments.value.map((root) => ({
471 ...root,
472 replies: flattenReplies(root.children)
473 }))
474 )
475 const loginLink = computed(() => {
476 const redirect = encodeURIComponent(route.fullPath)
477 return `/login?redirect=${redirect}`
478 })
479
480 async function load() {
481 loading.value = true
482 error.value = ''
483 detail.value = null
484 author.value = null
485 comments.value = []
486 replyTo.value = null
487 const id = route.params.id
488 try {
489 const endpoint = auth.isLoggedIn()
490 ? `/api/notes/${id}`
491 : `/api/public/notes/${id}`
492 const data = await api.get(endpoint)
493 detail.value = data
494 if (data && data.note && data.note.userId) {
495 loadAuthor(data.note.userId)
496 }
497 if (data && data.note && data.note.isPublic === 1) {
498 loadComments()
499 }
500 } catch (err) {
501 error.value = err.message || '笔记加载失败'
502 notifyError(err)
503 } finally {
504 loading.value = false
505 }
506 }
507
508 async function loadAuthor(userId) {
509 try {
510 author.value = await api.get(`/api/public/users/${userId}`)
511 } catch (err) {
512 author.value = null
513 }
514 }
515
516 async function loadComments() {
517 const id = route.params.id
518 commentsLoading.value = true
519 commentsError.value = ''
520 try {
521 const data = await api.get(`/api/public/notes/${id}/comments`)
522 comments.value = Array.isArray(data) ? data : []
523 if (detail.value && detail.value.note) {
524 detail.value.note.commentCount = countComments(comments.value)
525 }
526 } catch (err) {
527 commentsError.value = err.message || '评论加载失败'
528 } finally {
529 commentsLoading.value = false
530 }
531 }
532
533 async function submitComment() {
534 const content = commentContent.value.trim()
535 if (!content) {
536 notifyError('评论内容不能为空')
537 return
538 }
539 if (content.length > 500) {
540 notifyError('评论内容不能超过 500 个字符')
541 return
542 }
543 submittingComment.value = true
544 try {
545 await api.post(`/api/notes/${route.params.id}/comments`, {
546 content,
547 parentId: null
548 })
549 commentContent.value = ''
550 notifySuccess('评论发表成功')
551 await loadComments()
552 } catch (err) {
553 notifyError(err)
554 } finally {
555 submittingComment.value = false
556 }
557 }
558
559 function startReply(root, child) {
560 if (isReplyingChild(root, child) || (!child && isReplyingRoot(root))) {
561 cancelReply()
562 return
563 }
564 replyTo.value = {
565 rootId: root.id,
566 targetId: child ? child.id : null,
567 targetName: child ? child.nickname : root.nickname
568 }
569 replyContent.value = ''
570 }
571
572 function cancelReply() {
573 replyTo.value = null
574 replyContent.value = ''
575 }
576
577 function isReplyingRoot(root) {
578 return Boolean(replyTo.value && replyTo.value.rootId === root.id && !replyTo.value.targetId)
579 }
580
581 function isReplyingChild(root, child) {
582 return Boolean(
583 replyTo.value && replyTo.value.rootId === root.id && replyTo.value.targetId === child.id
584 )
585 }
586
587 async function submitReply(root) {
588 const raw = replyContent.value.trim()
589 if (!raw) {
590 notifyError('回复内容不能为空')
591 return
592 }
593 if (!replyTo.value) return
594 const targetId = replyTo.value.targetId
595 const targetName = replyTo.value.targetName
596 const content = targetId ? `回复 @${targetName}：${raw}` : raw
597 if (content.length > 500) {
598 notifyError('回复内容不能超过 500 个字符')
599 return
600 }
601 submittingReply.value = true
602 try {
603 await api.post(`/api/notes/${route.params.id}/comments`, {
604 content,
605 parentId: targetId || root.id
606 })
607 notifySuccess('回复成功')
608 cancelReply()
609 await loadComments()
610 } catch (err) {
611 notifyError(err)
612 } finally {
613 submittingReply.value = false
614 }
615 }
616
617 function canDelete(comment) {
618 if (!loggedIn.value || !comment) return false
619 if (auth.isAdmin()) return true
620 return comment.userId === currentUser.value.id
621 }
622
623 async function removeComment(comment) {
624 if (!comment) return
625 if (!window.confirm('确定删除这条评论吗？其下的回复也会一并删除。')) return
626 try {
627 if (auth.isAdmin()) {
628 await api.delete(`/api/admin/comments/${comment.id}`)
629 } else {
630 await api.delete(`/api/comments/${comment.id}`)
631 }
632 notifySuccess('评论已删除')
633 await loadComments()
634 } catch (err) {
635 notifyError(err)
636 }
637 }
638
639 async function toggleLike() {
640 if (!loggedIn.value) {
641 router.push({ name: 'login', query: { redirect: route.fullPath } })
642 return
643 }
644 liking.value = true
645 try {
646 const data = await api.post(`/api/notes/${route.params.id}/like`)
647 if (detail.value) {
648 detail.value.liked = Boolean(data && data.liked)
649 if (detail.value.note) {
650 detail.value.note.likeCount = Number(data && data.likeCount) || 0
651 }
652 }
653 notifySuccess(detail.value && detail.value.liked ? '已点赞' : '已取消点赞')
654 } catch (err) {
655 notifyError(err)
656 } finally {
657 liking.value = false
658 }
659 }
660
661 async function removeNote() {
662 if (!detail.value) return
663 if (!window.confirm('确定删除这篇笔记吗？删除后无法恢复。')) return
664 deleting.value = true
665 try {
666 await api.delete(`/api/notes/${note.value.id}`)
667 notifySuccess('笔记已删除')
668 router.replace('/me')
669 } catch (err) {
670 notifyError(err)
671 } finally {
672 deleting.value = false
673 }
674 }
675
676 function openLightbox(index) {
677 lightboxIndex.value = index
678 }
679
680 function closeLightbox() {
681 lightboxIndex.value = null
682 }
683
684 function stepLightbox(step) {
685 if (lightboxIndex.value === null) return
686 const length = images.value.length
687 if (!length) return
688 lightboxIndex.value = (lightboxIndex.value + step + length) % length
689 }
690
691 function handleKeydown(event) {
692 if (lightboxIndex.value === null) return
693 if (event.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox()
694 if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') stepLightbox(-1)
695 if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') stepLightbox(1)
696 }
697
698 onMounted(() => {
699 load()
700 window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown)
701 })
702
703 onBeforeUnmount(() => {
704 window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown)
705 })
706
707 return {
708 detail,
709 loading,
710 error,
711 author,
712 deleting,
713 liking,
714 comments,
715 commentsLoading,
716 commentsError,
717 commentContent,
718 submittingComment,
719 replyTo,
720 replyContent,
721 submittingReply,
722 lightboxIndex,
723 note,
724 images,
725 liked,
726 loggedIn,
727 currentUser,
728 owner,
729 canComment,
730 canLike,
731 statusMeta,
732 commentTotal,
733 commentTree,
734 loginLink,
735 load,
736 loadComments,
737 submitComment,
738 startReply,
739 cancelReply,
740 isReplyingRoot,
741 isReplyingChild,
742 submitReply,
743 canDelete,
744 removeComment,
745 toggleLike,
746 removeNote,
747 openLightbox,
748 closeLightbox,
749 stepLightbox,
750 aiTypeLabel,
751 formatDate,
752 timeAgo,
753 mediaUrl
754 }
755 }
756}
757</script>

205<script>
206import { computed, onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue'
207import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
208import api, { uploadFile } from '@/api'
209import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
210import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
211import { mediaUrl } from '@/utils/format'
212
213const MAX_IMAGES = 9
214const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024
215const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp']
216
217export default {
218 name: 'NoteEditorView',
219 components: { EmptyState },
220 setup() {
221 const route = useRoute()
222 const router = useRouter()
223
224 const isEdit = computed(() => route.name === 'note-edit')
225 const detail = ref(null)
226 const loadingNote = ref(isEdit.value)
227 const loadError = ref('')
228 const submitting = ref(false)
229 const submitError = ref('')
230
231 const uploading = ref(false)
232 const uploadTotal = ref(0)
233 const uploadDone = ref(0)
234 const uploadError = ref('')
235
236 const form = reactive({
237 bookName: '',
238 title: '',
239 content: '',
240 isPublic: 0,
241 images: []
242 })
243
244 const rejectReason = computed(() => {
245 if (!detail.value || !detail.value.note) return ''
246 return detail.value.note.rejectReason || ''
247 })
248
249 onMounted(async () => {
250 if (!isEdit.value) {
251 loadingNote.value = false
252 return
253 }
254 try {
255 const data = await api.get(`/api/notes/${route.params.id}`)
256 detail.value = data
257 const note = (data && data.note) || {}
258 form.bookName = note.bookName || ''
259 form.title = note.title || ''
260 form.content = note.content || ''
261 form.isPublic = note.isPublic === 1 ? 1 : 0
262 form.images = Array.isArray(data && data.images) ? [...data.images] : []
263 } catch (err) {
264 loadError.value = err.message || '笔记加载失败'
265 notifyError(err)
266 } finally {
267 loadingNote.value = false
268 }
269 })
270
271 function removeImage(index) {
272 form.images.splice(index, 1)
273 }
274
275 async function onFilesChange(event) {
276 const input = event.target
277 let files = Array.from(input.files || [])
278 input.value = ''
279 if (!files.length) return
280
281 uploadError.value = ''
282
283 const slots = MAX_IMAGES - form.images.length
284 if (slots <= 0) {
285 uploadError.value = `最多只能上传 ${MAX_IMAGES} 张图片`
286 notifyError(uploadError.value)
287 return
288 }
289 if (files.length > slots) {
290 notifyError(`最多还能上传 ${slots} 张，已自动截取前 ${slots} 张`)
291 files = files.slice(0, slots)
292 }
293
294 const invalid = files.find(
295 (file) => !ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type) || file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE
296 )
297 if (invalid) {
298 uploadError.value = `“${invalid.name}”格式不支持或超过 10MB，仅支持 JPG / PNG / GIF / WebP`
299 notifyError(uploadError.value)
300 return
301 }
302
303 uploading.value = true
304 uploadTotal.value = files.length
305 uploadDone.value = 0
306 try {
307 for (const file of files) {
308 const data = await uploadFile(file)
309 if (!data || !data.url) {
310 throw new Error('上传成功但未返回图片地址')
311 }
312 form.images.push(data.url)
313 uploadDone.value += 1
314 }
315 notifySuccess(`成功上传 ${uploadDone.value} 张图片`)
316 } catch (err) {
317 uploadError.value = err.message || '图片上传失败'
318 notifyError(err)
319 } finally {
320 uploading.value = false
321 uploadTotal.value = 0
322 uploadDone.value = 0
323 }
324 }
325
326 function validate() {
327 if (!form.bookName.trim()) return '请填写书名'
328 if (form.bookName.trim().length > 100) return '书名不能超过 100 个字符'
329 if (!form.title.trim()) return '请填写标题'
330 if (form.title.trim().length > 100) return '标题不能超过 100 个字符'
331 if (!form.content.trim()) return '正文不能为空'
332 if (form.images.length > MAX_IMAGES) return `最多上传 ${MAX_IMAGES} 张图片`
333 return ''
334 }
335
336 async function submit() {
337 submitError.value = ''
338 const message = validate()
339 if (message) {
340 submitError.value = message
341 notifyError(message)
342 return
343 }
344
345 submitting.value = true
346 try {
347 const payload = {
348 bookName: form.bookName.trim(),
349 title: form.title.trim(),
350 content: form.content.trim(),
351 isPublic: form.isPublic,
352 images: [...form.images]
353 }
354
355 let data
356 if (isEdit.value) {
357 data = await api.put(`/api/notes/${route.params.id}`, payload)
358 } else {
359 data = await api.post('/api/notes', payload)
360 }
361
362 if (payload.isPublic === 1) {
363 notifySuccess(
364 isEdit.value ? '已保存，公开笔记已重新提交审核' : '已提交审核，审核通过后将在首页展示'
365 )
366 } else {
367 notifySuccess(isEdit.value ? '笔记已保存' : '笔记已发布，仅自己可见')
368 }
369
370 const newId = data && data.note ? data.note.id : route.params.id
371 if (!isEdit.value && payload.isPublic === 0 && newId) {
372 router.replace(`/notes/${newId}`)
373 } else {
374 router.replace('/me')
375 }
376 } catch (err) {
377 submitError.value = err.message || '保存失败，请稍后重试'
378 notifyError(err)
379 } finally {
380 submitting.value = false
381 }
382 }
383
384 return {
385 isEdit,
386 detail,
387 loadingNote,
388 loadError,
389 submitting,
390 submitError,
391 uploading,
392 uploadTotal,
393 uploadDone,
394 uploadError,
395 form,
396 rejectReason,
397 removeImage,
398 onFilesChange,
399 submit,
400 mediaUrl
401 }
402 }
403}
404</script>

218<script>
219import { computed, onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue'
220import api, { uploadFile } from '@/api'
221import auth from '@/store/auth'
222import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
223import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
224import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
225import { formatDate } from '@/utils/format'
226
227const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp']
228const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024
229
230export default {
231 name: 'ProfileView',
232 components: { UserAvatar, EmptyState },
233 setup() {
234 const user = ref(null)
235 const loading = ref(true)
236 const error = ref('')
237 const saving = ref(false)
238 const saveError = ref('')
239 const saved = ref(false)
240 const savedAt = ref('')
241
242 const uploadingAvatar = ref(false)
243
244 const form = reactive({ nickname: '', bio: '', avatar: '' })
245 const counts = reactive({ followers: 0, following: 0 })
246 const activeList = ref('followers')
247 const people = ref([])
248 const peopleTotal = ref(0)
249 const peopleLoading = ref(false)
250 const peopleError = ref('')
251
252 const isAdmin = computed(() => Boolean(user.value && user.value.role === 'ADMIN'))
253
254 function fillForm(data) {
255 form.nickname = data.nickname || ''
256 form.bio = data.bio || ''
257 form.avatar = data.avatar || ''
258 }
259
260 async function loadProfile() {
261 loading.value = true
262 error.value = ''
263 try {
264 const data = await api.get('/api/users/me')
265 user.value = data
266 fillForm(data)
267 saved.value = false
268 await Promise.all([loadCounts(data.id), loadPeople(activeList.value, data.id)])
269 } catch (err) {
270 error.value = err.message || '个人资料加载失败'
271 notifyError(err)
272 } finally {
273 loading.value = false
274 }
275 }
276
277 async function loadCounts(userId) {
278 try {
279 const [followers, following] = await Promise.all([
280 api.get(`/api/users/${userId}/followers`, { params: { page: 1, size: 1 } }),
281 api.get(`/api/users/${userId}/following`, { params: { page: 1, size: 1 } })
282 ])
283 counts.followers = Number(followers && followers.total) || 0
284 counts.following = Number(following && following.total) || 0
285 } catch (err) {
286 notifyError(err)
287 }
288 }
289
290 async function loadPeople(kind = activeList.value, userId = null) {
291 const id = userId || (user.value && user.value.id)
292 if (!id) return
293 peopleLoading.value = true
294 peopleError.value = ''
295 try {
296 const data = await api.get(`/api/users/${id}/${kind}`, {
297 params: { page: 1, size: 10 }
298 })
299 people.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
300 peopleTotal.value = Number(data.total) || 0
301 } catch (err) {
302 peopleError.value = err.message || '列表加载失败'
303 } finally {
304 peopleLoading.value = false
305 }
306 }
307
308 function selectList(kind) {
309 if (kind === activeList.value && people.value.length) return
310 activeList.value = kind
311 loadPeople(kind)
312 }
313
314 function resetForm() {
315 if (!user.value) return
316 fillForm(user.value)
317 saveError.value = ''
318 saved.value = false
319 }
320
321 async function onAvatarChange(event) {
322 const input = event.target
323 const file = input.files && input.files[0]
324 input.value = ''
325 if (!file) return
326 if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type) || file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
327 const message = '头像仅支持 JPG / PNG / GIF / WebP，且不超过 10MB'
328 saveError.value = message
329 notifyError(message)
330 return
331 }
332 uploadingAvatar.value = true
333 saveError.value = ''
334 try {
335 const data = await uploadFile(file)
336 if (!data || !data.url) throw new Error('上传成功但未返回图片地址')
337 form.avatar = data.url
338 notifySuccess('头像上传成功，点击「保存资料」后生效')
339 } catch (err) {
340 saveError.value = err.message || '头像上传失败'
341 notifyError(err)
342 } finally {
343 uploadingAvatar.value = false
344 }
345 }
346
347 async function saveProfile() {
348 saveError.value = ''
349 saved.value = false
350 if (form.nickname.length > 32) {
351 saveError.value = '昵称不能超过 32 个字符'
352 return
353 }
354 if (form.bio.length > 200) {
355 saveError.value = '简介不能超过 200 个字符'
356 return
357 }
358 saving.value = true
359 try {
360 const data = await api.put('/api/users/me', {
361 nickname: form.nickname.trim(),
362 bio: form.bio.trim(),
363 avatar: form.avatar.trim()
364 })
365 user.value = data
366 fillForm(data)
367 auth.setUser(data)
368 saved.value = true
369 savedAt.value = formatDate(new Date().toISOString())
370 notifySuccess('个人资料已保存')
371 } catch (err) {
372 saveError.value = err.message || '保存失败，请稍后重试'
373 notifyError(err)
374 } finally {
375 saving.value = false
376 }
377 }
378
379 onMounted(loadProfile)
380
381 return {
382 user,
383 loading,
384 error,
385 saving,
386 saveError,
387 saved,
388 savedAt,
389 uploadingAvatar,
390 form,
391 counts,
392 activeList,
393 people,
394 peopleTotal,
395 peopleLoading,
396 peopleError,
397 isAdmin,
398 loadProfile,
399 loadPeople,
400 selectList,
401 resetForm,
402 onAvatarChange,
403 saveProfile
404 }
405 }
406}
407</script>

89<script>
90import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'
91import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
92import AuthShell from '@/components/AuthShell.vue'
93import api from '@/api'
94import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
95
96export default {
97 name: 'RegisterView',
98 components: { AuthShell },
99 setup() {
100 const router = useRouter()
101 const form = reactive({
102 username: '',
103 nickname: '',
104 password: '',
105 confirmPassword: ''
106 })
107 const loading = ref(false)
108 const error = ref('')
109
110 function validate() {
111 const username = form.username.trim()
112 if (username.length < 4 || username.length > 32) {
113 return '用户名长度需为 4–32 个字符'
114 }
115 if (form.nickname.trim().length > 32) {
116 return '昵称不能超过 32 个字符'
117 }
118 if (form.password.length < 6 || form.password.length > 32) {
119 return '密码长度需为 6–32 个字符'
120 }
121 if (form.password !== form.confirmPassword) {
122 return '两次输入的密码不一致'
123 }
124 return ''
125 }
126
127 async function submit() {
128 error.value = ''
129 const message = validate()
130 if (message) {
131 error.value = message
132 return
133 }
134 loading.value = true
135 try {
136 const payload = {
137 username: form.username.trim(),
138 password: form.password
139 }
140 if (form.nickname.trim()) payload.nickname = form.nickname.trim()
141 await api.post('/api/auth/register', payload)
142 notifySuccess('注册成功，请登录')
143 router.replace({ name: 'login', query: { username: payload.username, registered: '1' } })
144 } catch (err) {
145 error.value = err.message || '注册失败，请稍后重试'
146 notifyError(err)
147 } finally {
148 loading.value = false
149 }
150 }
151
152 return { form, loading, error, submit }
153 }
154}
155</script>

168 margin-bottom: 15px;
169}

137<script>
138import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
139import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
140import api from '@/api'
141import auth from '@/store/auth'
142import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
143import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
144import NoteCard from '@/components/NoteCard.vue'
145import AppPagination from '@/components/AppPagination.vue'
146import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
147import { hydrateNoteCovers } from '@/utils/hydrate'
148
149const PAGE_SIZE = 6
150
151export default {
152 name: 'UserProfileView',
153 components: { UserAvatar, NoteCard, AppPagination, EmptyState },
154 setup() {
155 const route = useRoute()
156 const router = useRouter()
157
158 const profile = ref(null)
159 const loading = ref(true)
160 const error = ref('')
161 const following = ref(false)
162 const followBusy = ref(false)
163
164 const notes = ref([])
165 const total = ref(0)
166 const page = ref(1)
167 const notesLoading = ref(true)
168 const notesError = ref('')
169 const size = PAGE_SIZE
170 let notesSeed = 0
171
172 const loggedIn = computed(() => auth.isLoggedIn())
173 const isSelf = computed(() => {
174 const user = auth.state.user
175 return Boolean(user && profile.value && user.id === profile.value.id)
176 })
177
178 async function loadProfile() {
179 loading.value = true
180 error.value = ''
181 try {
182 const data = await api.get(`/api/public/users/${route.params.id}`)
183 profile.value = data
184 following.value = Boolean(data.followed)
185 if (loggedIn.value && !isSelf.value) {
186 checkFollowing(data.id)
187 }
188 } catch (err) {
189 error.value = err.message || '作者信息加载失败'
190 notifyError(err)
191 } finally {
192 loading.value = false
193 }
194 }
195
196 /**
197 * 公开作者接口的 followed 字段依赖当前用户，但后端公开接口未传当前用户。
198 * 这里通过「我关注的人」列表补一次关注状态，失败时忽略。
199 */
200 async function checkFollowing(targetId) {
201 try {
202 const data = await api.get(
203 `/api/users/${auth.state.user.id}/following`,
204 { params: { page: 1, size: 200 } }
205 )
206 const records = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
207 if (records.some((item) => item.id === targetId)) {
208 following.value = true
209 }
210 } catch (err) {
211 // 关注状态修正失败不阻塞页面
212 }
213 }
214
215 async function loadNotes() {
216 const seed = ++notesSeed
217 notesLoading.value = true
218 notesError.value = ''
219 try {
220 const data = await api.get(`/api/public/users/${route.params.id}/notes`, {
221 params: { page: page.value, size: PAGE_SIZE }
222 })
223 if (seed !== notesSeed) return
224 notes.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
225 total.value = Number(data.total) || 0
226 hydrateNoteCovers(notes.value, () => seed !== notesSeed)
227 } catch (err) {
228 if (seed !== notesSeed) return
229 notesError.value = err.message || '笔记列表加载失败'
230 notes.value = []
231 total.value = 0
232 } finally {
233 if (seed === notesSeed) notesLoading.value = false
234 }
235 }
236
237 function changePage(next) {
238 page.value = next
239 loadNotes()
240 window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
241 }
242
243 async function toggleFollow() {
244 if (!loggedIn.value) {
245 router.push({ name: 'login', query: { redirect: route.fullPath } })
246 return
247 }
248 if (!profile.value || isSelf.value) return
249 followBusy.value = true
250 try {
251 const data = following.value
252 ? await api.delete(`/api/users/${profile.value.id}/follow`)
253 : await api.post(`/api/users/${profile.value.id}/follow`)
254 following.value = Boolean(data && data.followed)
255 if (data && typeof data.fansCount !== 'undefined') {
256 profile.value.fansCount = Number(data.fansCount) || 0
257 }
258 notifySuccess(following.value ? '已关注这位作者' : '已取消关注')
259 } catch (err) {
260 notifyError(err)
261 } finally {
262 followBusy.value = false
263 }
264 }
265
266 onMounted(() => {
267 loadProfile()
268 loadNotes()
269 })
270
271 return {
272 profile,
273 loading,
274 error,
275 following,
276 followBusy,
277 notes,
278 total,
279 page,
280 size,
281 notesLoading,
282 notesError,
283 loggedIn,
284 isSelf,
285 loadProfile,
286 loadNotes,
287 changePage,
288 toggleFollow
289 }
290 }
291}
292</script>

99<script>
100import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
101import api from '@/api'
102import { notifyError } from '@/store/toast'
103import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
104
105const SCENE_LABELS = {
106 SUMMARY: '阅读总结',
107 AUDIENCE: '适合人群',
108 SCORE: '质量评分',
109 CHAT: '智能客服'
110}
111
112export default {
113 name: 'AdminAiStats',
114 components: { EmptyState },
115 setup() {
116 const stats = ref({})
117 const loading = ref(true)
118 const error = ref('')
119
120 const rows = computed(() => (Array.isArray(stats.value.byScene) ? stats.value.byScene : []))
121
122 const successRate = computed(() => {
123 const total = Number(stats.value.total) || 0
124 const success = Number(stats.value.success) || 0
125 if (!total) return 0
126 return Math.round((success / total) * 100)
127 })
128
129 function formatNumber(value) {
130 return (Number(value) || 0).toLocaleString('zh-CN')
131 }
132
133 function sceneLabel(scene) {
134 return SCENE_LABELS[scene] || scene || '未知场景'
135 }
136
137 function rowFail(row) {
138 return Math.max(0, (Number(row.total) || 0) - (Number(row.success) || 0))
139 }
140
141 function rowRate(row) {
142 const total = Number(row.total) || 0
143 if (!total) return 0
144 return Math.round(((Number(row.success) || 0) / total) * 100)
145 }
146
147 async function load() {
148 loading.value = true
149 error.value = ''
150 try {
151 stats.value = await api.get('/api/admin/ai/stats')
152 } catch (err) {
153 error.value = err.message || 'AI 统计加载失败'
154 notifyError(err)
155 } finally {
156 loading.value = false
157 }
158 }
159
160 onMounted(load)
161
162 return {
163 stats,
164 loading,
165 error,
166 rows,
167 successRate,
168 formatNumber,
169 sceneLabel,
170 rowFail,
171 rowRate,
172 load
173 }
174 }
175}
176</script>

107]

110 name: 'AdminDashboard',
111 components: { EmptyState },

147 }
148}

133<script>
134import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
135import api from '@/api'
136import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
137import AppPagination from '@/components/AppPagination.vue'
138import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
139import { formatDate, noteStatusMeta } from '@/utils/format'
140
141const PAGE_SIZE = 10
142
143export default {
144 name: 'AdminNotes',
145 components: { AppPagination, EmptyState },
146 setup() {
147 const notes = ref([])
148 const total = ref(0)
149 const page = ref(1)
150 const size = PAGE_SIZE
151 const statusFilter = ref('')
152 const keyword = ref('')
153 const appliedKeyword = ref('')
154 const loading = ref(true)
155 const error = ref('')
156 const takingId = ref(null)
157 let seed = 0
158
159 async function load() {
160 const current = ++seed
161 loading.value = true
162 error.value = ''
163 try {
164 const params = { page: page.value, size: PAGE_SIZE }
165 if (statusFilter.value !== '') params.status = Number(statusFilter.value)
166 if (appliedKeyword.value) params.keyword = appliedKeyword.value
167 const data = await api.get('/api/admin/notes', { params })
168 if (current !== seed) return
169 notes.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
170 total.value = Number(data.total) || 0
171 const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total.value / PAGE_SIZE))
172 if (page.value > totalPages) {
173 page.value = totalPages
174 load()
175 }
176 } catch (err) {
177 if (current !== seed) return
178 error.value = err.message || '笔记列表加载失败'
179 notes.value = []
180 total.value = 0
181 notifyError(err)
182 } finally {
183 if (current === seed) loading.value = false
184 }
185 }
186
187 function search() {
188 appliedKeyword.value = keyword.value.trim()
189 page.value = 1
190 load()
191 }
192
193 function onFilterChange() {
194 page.value = 1
195 load()
196 }
197
198 function clearFilters() {
199 statusFilter.value = ''
200 keyword.value = ''
201 appliedKeyword.value = ''
202 page.value = 1
203 load()
204 }
205
206 function changePage(next) {
207 page.value = next
208 load()
209 }
210
211 async function takeDown(note) {
212 if (!note) return
213 if (!window.confirm(`确定下架《${note.title || '无标题笔记'}》吗？下架后仅作者自己可见。`)) return
214 takingId.value = note.id
215 try {
216 await api.put(`/api/admin/notes/${note.id}/take-down`)
217 notifySuccess('笔记已下架')
218 await load()
219 } catch (err) {
220 notifyError(err)
221 } finally {
222 takingId.value = null
223 }
224 }
225
226 onMounted(load)
227
228 return {
229 notes,
230 total,
231 page,
232 size,
233 statusFilter,
234 keyword,
235 appliedKeyword,
236 loading,
237 error,
238 takingId,
239 load,
240 search,
241 onFilterChange,
242 clearFilters,
243 changePage,
244 takeDown,
245 formatDate,
246 statusMeta: noteStatusMeta
247 }
248 }
249}
250</script>

118<script>
119import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
120import api from '@/api'
121import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
122import AppPagination from '@/components/AppPagination.vue'
123import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
124import { excerpt, formatDate } from '@/utils/format'
125
126const PAGE_SIZE = 6
127
128export default {
129 name: 'AdminReview',
130 components: { AppPagination, EmptyState },
131 setup() {
132 const notes = ref([])
133 const total = ref(0)
134 const page = ref(1)
135 const size = PAGE_SIZE
136 const loading = ref(true)
137 const error = ref('')
138 const reviewingId = ref(null)
139 const expandedId = ref(null)
140
141 const rejectTarget = ref(null)
142 const rejectReason = ref('')
143 const rejecting = ref(false)
144
145 let seed = 0
146
147 async function load() {
148 const current = ++seed
149 loading.value = true
150 error.value = ''
151 try {
152 const data = await api.get('/api/admin/notes/pending', {
153 params: { page: page.value, size: PAGE_SIZE }
154 })
155 if (current !== seed) return
156 notes.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
157 total.value = Number(data.total) || 0
158 const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total.value / PAGE_SIZE))
159 if (page.value > totalPages) {
160 page.value = totalPages
161 load()
162 }
163 } catch (err) {
164 if (current !== seed) return
165 error.value = err.message || '待审核列表加载失败'
166 notes.value = []
167 total.value = 0
168 notifyError(err)
169 } finally {
170 if (current === seed) loading.value = false
171 }
172 }
173
174 function changePage(next) {
175 page.value = next
176 expandedId.value = null
177 load()
178 }
179
180 function toggleExpand(id) {
181 expandedId.value = expandedId.value === id ? null : id
182 }
183
184 async function afterReview() {
185 if (notes.value.length === 1 && page.value > 1) {
186 page.value -= 1
187 }
188 expandedId.value = null
189 await load()
190 }
191
192 async function approve(note) {
193 if (!note) return
194 if (!window.confirm(`确定通过《${note.title || '无标题笔记'}》的审核吗？`)) return
195 reviewingId.value = note.id
196 try {
197 await api.post(`/api/admin/notes/${note.id}/review`, {
198 approved: true,
199 reason: ''
200 })
201 notifySuccess('审核已通过，笔记已发布到首页')
202 await afterReview()
203 } catch (err) {
204 notifyError(err)
205 } finally {
206 reviewingId.value = null
207 }
208 }
209
210 function openReject(note) {
211 rejectTarget.value = note
212 rejectReason.value = ''
213 }
214
215 function closeReject() {
216 if (rejecting.value) return
217 rejectTarget.value = null
218 rejectReason.value = ''
219 }
220
221 async function submitReject() {
222 if (!rejectTarget.value) return
223 rejecting.value = true
224 try {
225 await api.post(`/api/admin/notes/${rejectTarget.value.id}/review`, {
226 approved: false,
227 reason: rejectReason.value.trim()
228 })
229 notifySuccess('已驳回该笔记')
230 rejectTarget.value = null
231 rejectReason.value = ''
232 await afterReview()
233 } catch (err) {
234 notifyError(err)
235 } finally {
236 rejecting.value = false
237 }
238 }
239
240 onMounted(load)
241
242 return {
243 notes,
244 total,
245 page,
246 size,
247 loading,
248 error,
249 reviewingId,
250 expandedId,
251 rejectTarget,
252 rejectReason,
253 rejecting,
254 load,
255 changePage,
256 toggleExpand,
257 approve,
258 openReject,
259 closeReject,
260 submitReject,
261 excerpt,
262 formatDate
263 }
264 }
265}
266</script>

54 <td class="admin-users__id">#{{ user.id }}</td>

57 <UserAvatar :src="user.avatar" :name="user.nickname || user.username" :size="32" />
58 <div class="user-cell__info">
59 <strong>{{ user.nickname || user.username }}</strong>
60 <small>@{{ user.username }}</small>
61 </div>

65 <span class="badge" :class="user.role === 'ADMIN' ? 'badge-primary' : 'badge-muted'">
66 {{ user.role === 'ADMIN' ? '管理员' : '普通用户' }}
67 </span>
68 </td>
69 <td>
70 <span class="badge" :class="user.status === 1 ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-danger'">
71 {{ user.status === 1 ? '正常' : '已禁用' }}
72 </span>

76 <button
77 type="button"
78 class="btn btn-sm"
79 :class="user.status === 1 ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-outline'"
80 :disabled="togglingId === user.id || (user.role === 'ADMIN' && user.status === 1)"
81 :title="user.role === 'ADMIN' && user.status === 1 ? '管理员账号不可禁用' : ''"
82 @click="toggleStatus(user)"
83 >
84 <span v-if="togglingId === user.id" class="spinner spinner--dark"></span>
85 {{ user.status === 1 ? '禁用' : '启用' }}
86 </button>

94 <EmptyState
95 icon="◉"
96 :title="appliedKeyword ? '没有找到匹配的用户' : '还没有用户'"
97 :description="appliedKeyword ? `没有用户名或昵称包含「${appliedKeyword}」的用户。` : '社区里还没有注册用户。'"
98 >
99 <button v-if="appliedKeyword" type="button" class="btn btn-outline" @click="clearSearch">
100 清空搜索
101 </button>
102 </EmptyState>

110<script>
111import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
112import api from '@/api'
113import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from '@/store/toast'
114import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
115import AppPagination from '@/components/AppPagination.vue'
116import EmptyState from '@/components/EmptyState.vue'
117import { formatDate } from '@/utils/format'
118
119const PAGE_SIZE = 10
120
121export default {
122 name: 'AdminUsers',
123 components: { UserAvatar, AppPagination, EmptyState },
124 setup() {
125 const users = ref([])
126 const total = ref(0)
127 const page = ref(1)
128 const size = PAGE_SIZE
129 const keyword = ref('')
130 const appliedKeyword = ref('')
131 const loading = ref(true)
132 const error = ref('')
133 const togglingId = ref(null)
134 let seed = 0
135
136 async function load() {
137 const current = ++seed
138 loading.value = true
139 error.value = ''
140 try {
141 const params = { page: page.value, size: PAGE_SIZE }
142 if (appliedKeyword.value) params.keyword = appliedKeyword.value
143 const data = await api.get('/api/admin/users', { params })
144 if (current !== seed) return
145 users.value = Array.isArray(data.records) ? data.records : []
146 total.value = Number(data.total) || 0
147 const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total.value / PAGE_SIZE))
148 if (page.value > totalPages) {
149 page.value = totalPages
150 load()
151 }
152 } catch (err) {
153 if (current !== seed) return
154 error.value = err.message || '用户列表加载失败'
155 users.value = []
156 total.value = 0
157 notifyError(err)
158 } finally {
159 if (current === seed) loading.value = false
160 }
161 }
162
163 function search() {
164 appliedKeyword.value = keyword.value.trim()
165 page.value = 1
166 load()
167 }
168
169 function clearSearch() {
170 keyword.value = ''
171 appliedKeyword.value = ''
172 page.value = 1
173 load()
174 }
175
176 function changePage(next) {
177 page.value = next
178 load()
179 }
180
181 async function toggleStatus(user) {
182 if (!user) return
183 const target = user.status === 1 ? 0 : 1
184 if (user.role === 'ADMIN' && target === 0) {
185 notifyError('管理员账号不可禁用')
186 return
187 }
188 const action = target === 0 ? '禁用' : '启用'
189 if (!window.confirm(`确定要${action}用户「${user.nickname || user.username}」吗？`)) return
190 togglingId.value = user.id
191 try {
192 await api.put(`/api/admin/users/${user.id}/status?status=${target}`)
193 user.status = target
194 notifySuccess(`已${action}用户「${user.nickname || user.username}」`)
195 } catch (err) {
196 notifyError(err)
197 } finally {
198 togglingId.value = null
199 }
200 }
201
202 onMounted(load)
203
204 return {
205 users,
206 total,
207 page,
208 size,
209 keyword,
210 appliedKeyword,
211 loading,
212 error,
213 togglingId,
214 load,
215 search,
216 clearSearch,
217 changePage,
218 toggleStatus,
219 formatDate
220 }
221 }
222}
223</script>

1<template>
2 <nav v-if="totalPages > 1" class="pagination" aria-label="分页">
3 <button
4 class="pagination__btn"
5 type="button"
6 :disabled="page <= 1 || disabled"
7 @click="go(page - 1)"
8 >
9 上一页
10 </button>
11 <template v-for="(item, index) in pages" :key="`${item}-${index}`">
12 <span v-if="item === '...'" class="pagination__ellipsis">…</span>
13 <button
14 v-else
15 class="pagination__btn"
16 :class="{ 'is-active': item === page }"
17 type="button"
18 :disabled="disabled"
19 @click="go(item)"
20 >
21 {{ item }}
22 </button>
23 </template>
24 <button
25 class="pagination__btn"
26 type="button"
27 :disabled="page >= totalPages || disabled"
28 @click="go(page + 1)"
29 >
30 下一页
31 </button>
32 <span class="pagination__total">共 {{ total }} 条</span>
33 </nav>
34</template>
35
36<script>
37import { computed } from 'vue'
38
39export default {
40 name: 'AppPagination',
41 props: {
42 page: { type: Number, default: 1 },
43 size: { type: Number, default: 10 },
44 total: { type: Number, default: 0 },
45 disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false }
46 },
47 emits: ['change'],
48 setup(props, { emit }) {
49 const totalPages = computed(() =>
50 Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Number(props.total) || 0) / (Number(props.size) || 1)))
51 )
52
53 const pages = computed(() => {
54 const last = totalPages.value
55 if (last <= 7) {
56 return Array.from({ length: last }, (_, index) => index + 1)
57 }
58 const list = [1]
59 const start = Math.max(2, props.page - 1)
60 const end = Math.min(last - 1, props.page + 1)
61 if (start > 2) list.push('...')
62 for (let i = start; i <= end; i += 1) list.push(i)
63 if (end < last - 1) list.push('...')
64 list.push(last)
65 return list
66 })
67
68 function go(target) {
69 if (props.disabled) return
70 if (target < 1 || target > totalPages.value || target === props.page) return
71 emit('change', target)
72 }
73
74 return { totalPages, pages, go }
75 }
76}
77</script>

80<script>
81import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
82import UserAvatar from '@/components/UserAvatar.vue'
83import { excerpt, formatDate, mediaUrl, noteStatusMeta } from '@/utils/format'
84
85export default {
86 name: 'NoteCard',
87 components: { UserAvatar },
88 props: {
89 note: { type: Object, required: true },
90 showStatus: { type: Boolean, default: false }
91 },
92 setup(props) {
93 const coverFailed = ref(false)
94 const cover = computed(() => {
95 if (coverFailed.value) return ''
96 const images = props.note.images
97 return Array.isArray(images) && images.length ? mediaUrl(images[0]) : ''
98 })
99 const bookInitial = computed(() => {
100 const value = (props.note.bookName || props.note.title || '书').trim()
101 return value.slice(0, 2)
102 })
103 const statusMeta = computed(() => noteStatusMeta(props.note.status))
104
105 watch(
106 () => props.note.images,
107 () => {
108 coverFailed.value = false
109 }
110 )
111
112 return {
113 coverFailed,
114 cover,
115 bookInitial,
116 statusMeta,
117 excerpt,
118 formatDate
119 }
120 }
121}
122</script>

12<script>
13import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
14import { mediaUrl } from '@/utils/format'
15
16export default {
17 name: 'UserAvatar',
18 props: {
19 src: { type: String, default: '' },
20 name: { type: String, default: '' },
21 size: { type: Number, default: 36 }
22 },
23 setup(props) {
24 const broken = ref(false)
25 const resolvedSrc = computed(() => mediaUrl(props.src))
26 const showImage = computed(() => Boolean(props.src) && !broken.value)
27 const initial = computed(() => {
28 const value = (props.name || '用').trim()
29 return value ? value.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() : '用'
30 })
31
32 watch(
33 () => props.src,
34 () => {
35 broken.value = false
36 }
37 )
38
39 return { broken, resolvedSrc, showImage, initial }
40 }
41}
42</script>

1export const NOTE_STATUS = {
2 1: { label: '已发布', tone: 'success', hint: '笔记已发布' },
3 2: { label: '待审核', tone: 'warning', hint: '公开笔记正在等待管理员审核' },
4 3: { label: '已驳回', tone: 'danger', hint: '公开笔记未通过审核' },
5 0: { label: '已下架', tone: 'muted', hint: '笔记已被管理员下架' }
6}
7
8export const AI_TYPE_LABEL = {
9 SUMMARY: '内容总结',
10 AUDIENCE: '适合人群',
11 SCORE: '质量评分'
12}
13
14export function noteStatusMeta(status) {
15 return NOTE_STATUS[status] || { label: '未知', tone: 'muted', hint: '' }
16}
17
18export function aiTypeLabel(type) {
19 if (!type) return 'AI 辅助'
20 return AI_TYPE_LABEL[type] || type
21}
22
23function pad(value) {
24 return String(value).padStart(2, '0')
25}
26
27export function formatDate(value) {
28 if (!value) return ''
29 const date = new Date(value)
30 if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(value)
31 return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(
32 date.getHours()
33 )}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
34}
35
36export function timeAgo(value) {
37 if (!value) return ''
38 const date = new Date(value)
39 if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(value)
40 const diff = Date.now() - date.getTime()
41 if (diff < 0) return formatDate(value)
42 if (diff < 60 * 1000) return '刚刚'
43 if (diff < 60 * 60 * 1000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60000)} 分钟前`
44 if (diff < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600000)} 小时前`
45 if (diff < 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400000)} 天前`
46 return formatDate(value)
47}
48
49export function excerpt(text, length = 110) {
50 const value = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
51 if (!value) return '这篇笔记还没有正文。'
52 return value.length > length ? `${value.slice(0, length)}…` : value
53}
54
55export function mediaUrl(url) {
56 const value = String(url || '').trim()
57 if (!value) return ''
58 if (/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(value) || value.startsWith('data:') || value.startsWith('blob:')) {
59 return value
60 }
61 return value.startsWith('/') ? value : `/${value}`
62}
63
64export function displayName(user) {
65 if (!user) return '匿名用户'
66 return user.nickname || user.username || '匿名用户'
67}
68
69export function countComments(list) {
70 if (!Array.isArray(list)) return 0
71 return list.reduce((sum, item) => sum + 1 + countComments(item.children), 0)
72}
73
74export function flattenReplies(children) {
75 const result = []
76 const walk = (items) => {
77 if (!Array.isArray(items)) return
78 items.forEach((item) => {
79 result.push(item)
80 walk(item.children)
81 })
82 }
83 walk(children)
84 return result
85}

hydrate.js frontend/src/utils/hydrate.js 27 行 VS Code 打开
1import api from '@/api'
2
3/**
4 * 列表接口不返回配图，这里仅在缺少 images 时逐个补取详情，用于展示首图。
5 * 失败时保持占位图，不影响列表主流程。
6 */
7export async function hydrateNoteCovers(notes, isStale = () => false) {
8 if (!Array.isArray(notes)) return
9 const missing = notes.filter(
10 (note) => note && note.id && (!Array.isArray(note.images) || note.images.length === 0)
11 )
12 if (!missing.length) return
13
14 await Promise.allSettled(
15 missing.map(async (note) => {
16 try {
17 const detail = await api.get(`/api/public/notes/${note.id}`)
18 if (!isStale() && detail) {
19 note.images = Array.isArray(detail.images) ? detail.images : []
20 }
21 } catch (error) {
22 if (!isStale()) note.images = []
23 }
24 })
25 )
26}

1-- 笔记工坊 Note-Workshop 全量建表脚本（V2）
2-- MySQL 8.x
3
4CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS note_workshop
5 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
6 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
7
8USE note_workshop;
9
10-- 用户表
11CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user` (
12 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
13 username VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '登录名',
14 password VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'BCrypt 哈希',
15 nickname VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '昵称',
16 avatar VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '头像 URL',
17 bio VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '个人简介',
18 role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER' COMMENT 'USER / ADMIN',
19 status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1 正常 0 禁用',
20 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
21 updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
22 PRIMARY KEY (id),
23 UNIQUE KEY uk_user_username (username)
24) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='用户';
25
26-- 读书笔记表
27CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note (
28 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
29 user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '作者',
30 book_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '图书名称',
31 title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '笔记标题',
32 content TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '笔记正文',
33 is_public TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '1 公开 0 私有',
34 status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1 正常 2 待审核 3 审核驳回 0 已下架',
35 reject_reason VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '驳回原因',
36 reviewed_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '审核时间',
37 like_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
38 comment_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
39 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
40 updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
41 PRIMARY KEY (id),
42 KEY idx_note_user (user_id),
43 KEY idx_note_public (is_public, status, like_count),
44 KEY idx_note_status (status)
45) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='读书笔记';
46
47-- 笔记配图表
48CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_image (
49 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
50 note_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
51 url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
52 sort INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
53 PRIMARY KEY (id),
54 KEY idx_img_note (note_id)
55) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='笔记配图';
56
57-- 点赞表
58CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_like (
59 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
60 user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
61 note_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
62 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
63 PRIMARY KEY (id),
64 UNIQUE KEY uk_like_user_note (user_id, note_id),
65 KEY idx_like_note (note_id)
66) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='点赞';
67
68-- 评论表（支持二级回复）
69CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comment (
70 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
71 note_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
72 user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
73 parent_id BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '0 为一级评论',
74 content VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
75 deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '逻辑删除',
76 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
77 PRIMARY KEY (id),
78 KEY idx_comment_note (note_id, deleted),
79 KEY idx_comment_parent (parent_id)
80) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='评论';
81

83CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS follow (
84 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
85 follower_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关注者',
86 followee_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '被关注者',
87 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
88 PRIMARY KEY (id),
89 UNIQUE KEY uk_follow (follower_id, followee_id),
90 KEY idx_follow_followee (followee_id)
91) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='关注';
92
93-- AI 辅助结果（一篇笔记仅保留一条）
94CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_ai (
95 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
96 note_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
97 type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'SUMMARY / AUDIENCE / SCORE',
98 content TEXT NOT NULL,
99 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
100 PRIMARY KEY (id),
101 UNIQUE KEY uk_ai_note (note_id)
102) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='笔记 AI 辅助结果';
103
104-- AI 调用日志（统计成功/失败）
105CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_call_log (
106 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
107 user_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL,
108 scene VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'SUMMARY/AUDIENCE/SCORE/CHAT',
109 success TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
110 error_msg VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
111 latency_ms INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
112 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
113 PRIMARY KEY (id),
114 KEY idx_ai_log_time (created_at),
115 KEY idx_ai_log_scene (scene)
116) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI 调用日志';
117
118-- AI 客服会话
119CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_chat_session (
120 id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
121 user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
122 title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '新的会话',
123 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
124 updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
125 PRIMARY KEY (id),
126 KEY idx_chat_session_user (user_id)
127) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI 客服会话';

129-- AI 客服消息

134 content TEXT NOT NULL,
135 created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
136 PRIMARY KEY (id),
137 KEY idx_chat_msg_session (session_id, id)
138) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI 客服消息';

9
10function expect(cond, msg) {
11 if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
12}
13
14async function call(method, path, { token, body, form, expectStatus } = {}) {
15 const headers = {};
16 if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
17 let payload;
18 if (form) {
19 payload = form;
20 } else if (body !== undefined) {
21 headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json; charset=utf-8';
22 payload = JSON.stringify(body);
23 }
24 const res = await fetch(BASE + path, { method, headers, body: payload });
25 if (expectStatus && res.status !== expectStatus) {
26 throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} != ${expectStatus}`);
27 }
28 const text = await res.text();
29 let json = null;
30 try { json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { /* 非 JSON（如静态文件） */ }
31 return { status: res.status, json, text };
32}
33
34async function t(name, fn) {
35 try {
36 await fn();
37 results.push({ name, ok: true });
38 console.log(` ✓ ${name}`);
39 } catch (e) {
40 results.push({ name, ok: false, detail: e.message });
41 console.log(` ✗ ${name} -> ${e.message}`);
42 }
43}

343 await t('恢复用户后可登录', async () => {

345 const r = await call('POST', '/api/auth/login', { body: { username: u2, password: pwd } });
346 expect(r.json.code === 0, r.json.message);
347 ctx.token2 = r.json.data.token;
348 });
349
350 await t('管理员按状态筛选笔记', async () => {
351 const r = await call('GET', '/api/admin/notes?page=1&size=20&status=1', { token: ctx.adminToken });
352 expect(r.json.code === 0, r.json.message);
353 });
354
355 await t('管理员删除违规评论', async () => {
356 const c = await call('POST', `/api/notes/${ctx.noteId}/comments`, { token: ctx.token2, body: { content: '违规内容' } });
357 const r = await call('DELETE', `/api/admin/comments/${c.json.data.id}`, { token: ctx.adminToken });
358 expect(r.json.code === 0, r.json.message);
359 });
360
361 await t('AI 状态接口', async () => {
362 const r = await call('GET', '/api/ai/status', { token: ctx.token2 });
363 expect(r.json.code === 0 && Array.isArray(r.json.data.scenes), '状态异常');
364 });
365
366 await t('AI 生成（无 Key 时优雅降级为 503）', async () => {
367 const r = await call('POST', `/api/ai/notes/${ctx.noteId}/generate`, { token: ctx.token2, body: { type: 'SUMMARY' } });
368 expect([0, 503].includes(r.json.code), `期望 0 或 503，实际 ${r.json.code}`);
369 ctx.aiCode = r.json.code;
370 ctx.aiContent = r.json.data?.content;

373 await t('AI 客服（无 Key 时优雅降级为 503）', async () => {

375 expect([0, 503].includes(r.json.code), `期望 0 或 503，实际 ${r.json.code}`);
376 });

378 await t('AI 会话列表', async () => {
379 const r = await call('GET', '/api/ai/sessions', { token: ctx.token2 });
380 expect(r.json.code === 0 && Array.isArray(r.json.data), '会话列表异常');
381 });

383 await t('保存 AI 结果到笔记', async () => {

385 const r = await call('POST', `/api/ai/notes/${ctx.noteId}/save`, {
386 token: ctx.token2, body: { type: 'SUMMARY', content }
387 });

389 const detail = await call('GET', `/api/notes/${ctx.noteId}`, { token: ctx.token2 });
390 expect(detail.json.data.aiType === 'SUMMARY', '详情未返回 AI 类型');
391 expect(detail.json.data.aiContent === content, '详情未返回 AI 内容');
392 });

394 await t('AI 统计接口', async () => {

396 expect(r.json.code === 0 && typeof r.json.data.total === 'number', '统计异常');

409 });

411 // 汇总
412 const passed = results.filter(r => r.ok).length;
413 const failed = results.length - passed;
414 console.log(`\n=== 结果：${passed}/${results.length} 通过，${failed} 失败 ===\n`);
415
416 const lines = [];

419 lines.push(`- 服务地址：${BASE}`);

421 lines.push('| # | 用例 | 结果 | 说明 |');
422 lines.push('|---|---|---|---|');
423 results.forEach((r, i) => {
424 lines.push(`| ${i + 1} | ${r.name} | ${r.ok ? '✅ 通过' : '❌ 失败'} | ${r.ok ? '' : (r.detail || '').replace(/\|/g, '\\|')} |`);
425 });

428 mkdirSync('docs', { recursive: true });
429 writeFileSync('docs/api-test-report.md', lines.join('\n'), 'utf8');
430 console.log('报告已生成：docs/api-test-report.md');
431
432 if (failed > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
433}

435main().catch(e => {

collect-source.mjs scripts/collect-source.mjs 128 行 VS Code 打开
1// 把项目源码按模块汇编成 Markdown，便于通读/打印/答辩翻阅
2// 用法：node scripts/collect-source.mjs
3import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
4import { join, relative, extname } from 'node:path';
5
6const ROOT = process.cwd();
7const OUT = 'docs/源码汇编';
8mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
9
10const IGNORE = new Set(['node_modules', 'target', 'dist', 'static', 'uploads', '.git', '.idea', '.ui-check', 'docs']);
11const LANG = {
12 '.java': 'java', '.js': 'javascript', '.mjs': 'javascript', '.vue': 'vue',
13 '.sql': 'sql', '.yml': 'yaml', '.yaml': 'yaml', '.xml': 'xml',
14 '.json': 'json', '.css': 'css', '.md': 'markdown', '.ps1': 'powershell', '.cmd': 'bat',
15};
16
17function walk(dir, acc = []) {
18 let entries;
19 try { entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return acc; }
20 for (const e of entries) {
21 if (IGNORE.has(e.name)) continue;
22 const full = join(dir, e.name);
23 if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, acc);
24 else acc.push(full);
25 }
26 return acc;
27}
28
29const groups = [
30 {
31 file: '01-后端.md',
32 title: '后端 Java 源码',
33 desc: 'Spring Boot 启动、通用、安全、业务模块，共 9 个包。',
34 roots: ['src/main/java'],
35 files: ['src/main/resources/application.yml'],
36 },
37 {
38 file: '02-前端.md',
39 title: '前端源码（Vue 3 + Vue CLI）',
40 desc: '入口、路由、状态、请求封装、11 个视图与 7 个组件。',
41 roots: ['frontend/src'],
42 files: ['frontend/vue.config.js', 'frontend/package.json'],
43 },
44 {
45 file: '03-数据库与脚本.md',
46 title: '数据库与测试脚本',
47 desc: '建表/升级 SQL、接口测试、UI 检查、文档生成脚本。',
48 roots: ['sql', 'scripts'],
49 files: ['pom.xml', '.gitignore'],
50 },
51];
52
53let totalFiles = 0;
54let totalLines = 0;
55const summary = [];
56
57for (const g of groups) {
58 const items = [];
59 for (const r of g.roots || []) {
60 for (const f of walk(join(ROOT, r))) {
61 if (g.file === '03' && /package-lock\.json$/.test(f)) continue;
62 if (/package-lock\.json$/.test(f)) continue;
63 items.push(f);
64 }
65 }
66 for (const f of g.files || []) {
67 try { if (statSync(join(ROOT, f)).isFile()) items.push(join(ROOT, f)); } catch { /* ignore */ }
68 }
69 items.sort((a, b) => relative(ROOT, a).localeCompare(relative(ROOT, b)));
70
71 const parts = [];
72 let lines = 0;
73 parts.push(`# ${g.title}`, '', `> ${g.desc}`, `> 共 ${items.length} 个文件`, '');
74
75 // TOC
76 parts.push('## 文件清单', '', '| # | 文件 | 行数 |', '| --- | --- | --- |');
77 items.forEach((f, i) => {
78 const rel = relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/');
79 const n = readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split('\n').length;
80 lines += n;
81 parts.push(`| ${i + 1} | \`${rel}\` | ${n} |`);
82 });
83 parts.push('');
84
85 // bodies
86 for (const f of items) {
87 const rel = relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/');
88 const code = readFileSync(f, 'utf8').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\s+$/, '');
89 const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()] || 'text';
90 parts.push('---', '', `### ${rel}`, '', '```' + lang, code, '```', '');
91 }
92
93 writeFileSync(join(OUT, g.file), parts.join('\n'), 'utf8');
94 summary.push({ title: g.title, file: g.file, files: items.length, lines });
95 totalFiles += items.length;
96 totalLines += lines;
97}
98
99const index = [
100 '# 项目源码汇编 · 总览',
101 '',
102 '> 由 `scripts/collect-source.mjs` 自动生成，按模块汇编全部源码，便于通读、打印和答辩翻阅。',
103 '',
104 '## 分册',
105 '',
106 '| 分册 | 内容 | 文件数 | 行数 |',
107 '| --- | --- | --- | --- |',
108 ...summary.map((s) => `| [${s.title}](${encodeURI(s.file)}) | ${s.file} | ${s.files} | ${s.lines} |`),
109 `| **合计** | — | **${totalFiles}** | **${totalLines}** |`,
110 '',
111 '## 建议阅读顺序（答辩向）',
112 '',
113 '1. 先看 `01-后端.md` 的 `security/`、`note/NoteService.java`、`comment/CommentService.java`；',
114 '2. 再看 `03-数据库与脚本.md` 的 `sql/schema.sql`，对照表结构；',
115 '3. 前端只看 `02-前端.md` 的 `api/index.js`、`router/index.js`，其余页面按需查；',
116 '4. 测试脚本看 `03` 里的 `scripts/api-test.mjs`，对应 56 个用例。',
117 '',
118 '## 说明',
119 '',
120 '- 已排除：`node_modules`、`target`、`dist`、`static`（前端构建产物）、`uploads`、`.git`、`docs`；',
121 '- 每册开头有文件清单（含行数），正文按路径排序；',
122 '- 重新生成：`node scripts/collect-source.mjs`。',
123].join('\n');
124
125writeFileSync(join(OUT, '00-总览.md'), index, 'utf8');
126console.log(`生成完成：${totalFiles} 个文件，${totalLines} 行`);
127for (const s of summary) console.log(` - ${OUT}/${s.file} ${s.files} 文件 / ${s.lines} 行`);
128

208<script>
209function expandAll(open){document.querySelectorAll('details.file').forEach(function(d){d.open=open;});}
210function focusHash(){
211 var h=location.hash.slice(1); if(!h) return;
212 var el=document.getElementById(h); if(!el) return;
213 var d=el.closest('details'); if(d) d.open=true;
214 setTimeout(function(){
215 el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});
216 el.classList.add('hl');
217 setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('hl');},1600);
218 },30);
219}
220window.addEventListener('hashchange',focusHash);
221window.addEventListener('load',focusHash);
222document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input',function(e){
223 var q=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
224 document.querySelectorAll('section.module').forEach(function(sec){
225 var any=false;
226 sec.querySelectorAll('details.file').forEach(function(d){
227 var hit=!q||d.dataset.path.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1;
228 d.style.display=hit?'':'none'; if(hit) any=true;
229 });
230 sec.style.display=any?'':'none';
231 });
232});
233</script>
234</body>
235</html>`;

export-db-html.mjs scripts/export-db-html.mjs 125 行 VS Code 打开
1// 导出数据库表结构为 HTML（浏览器可直接打开）
2// 用法：node scripts/export-db-html.mjs
3import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
4import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
5
6const MYSQL = 'C:/dev/mysql-8.4.9-winx64/bin/mysql.exe';
7const DB = 'note_workshop';
8const OUT = 'docs/数据库表结构.html';
9
10function query(sql) {
11 const out = execFileSync(MYSQL, [
12 '-u', 'root', '-p123456', '-h', '127.0.0.1',
13 '--batch', '--raw', '--default-character-set=utf8mb4',
14 DB, '-e', sql,
15 ], { encoding: 'buffer', maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
16 const text = out.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\n$/, '');
17 const lines = text.split('\n');
18 if (lines.length <= 1) return [];
19 const header = lines[0].split('\t');
20 return lines.slice(1).filter(Boolean).map((line) => {
21 const cells = line.split('\t');
22 const row = {};
23 header.forEach((h, i) => { row[h] = cells[i] ?? ''; });
24 return row;
25 });
26}
27
28const cols = query(
29 `SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_KEY,IFNULL(COLUMN_DEFAULT,'') AS COL_DEFAULT,EXTRA,COLUMN_COMMENT
30 FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='${DB}' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION`);
31
32const idx = query(
33 `SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,GROUP_CONCAT(COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY SEQ_IN_INDEX) AS IDX_COLS
34 FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='${DB}'
35 GROUP BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME`);
36
37const tbls = query(
38 `SELECT TABLE_NAME,TABLE_COMMENT,TABLE_ROWS
39 FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='${DB}' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME`);
40
41const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
42const keyTag = (k) => k === 'PRI' ? '<span class="tag pk">PK</span>'
43 : k === 'UNI' ? '<span class="tag uk">UNI</span>'
44 : k === 'MUL' ? '<span class="tag idx">IDX</span>' : '';
45
46const sections = tbls.map((t) => {
47 const name = t.TABLE_NAME;
48 const tcols = cols.filter((c) => c.TABLE_NAME === name);
49 const tidx = idx.filter((i) => i.TABLE_NAME === name);
50 const rows = tcols.map((c, i) => `<tr>
51 <td>${i + 1}</td>
52 <td><code>${esc(c.COLUMN_NAME)}</code></td>
53 <td><code>${esc(c.COLUMN_TYPE)}</code></td>
54 <td>${esc(c.IS_NULLABLE)}</td>
55 <td>${keyTag(c.COLUMN_KEY)}</td>
56 <td>${esc(c.COL_DEFAULT)}</td>
57 <td>${esc(c.COLUMN_COMMENT)}</td>
58 </tr>`).join('\n');
59
60 const idxRows = tidx.map((i) => `<tr>
61 <td><code>${esc(i.INDEX_NAME)}</code></td>
62 <td>${i.NON_UNIQUE === '0' ? '是' : '否'}</td>
63 <td>${esc(i.IDX_COLS)}</td>
64 </tr>`).join('\n');
65
66 return `<section class="card" id="t-${name}">
67 <h2>${esc(name)} <span class="sub">${esc(t.TABLE_COMMENT)}</span></h2>
68 <div class="meta">约 ${esc(t.TABLE_ROWS)} 行（InnoDB 估算） · ${tcols.length} 个字段 · ${tidx.length} 个索引</div>
69 <table>
70 <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>字段</th><th>类型</th><th>可空</th><th>键</th><th>默认</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead>
71 <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
72 </table>
73 <div class="meta" style="margin-top:12px">索引</div>
74 <table>
75 <thead><tr><th>名称</th><th>唯一</th><th>字段</th></tr></thead>
76 <tbody>${idxRows}</tbody>
77 </table>
78</section>`;
79}).join('\n');
80
81const nav = tbls.map((t) => `<a href="#t-${t.TABLE_NAME}">${t.TABLE_NAME}</a>`).join('');
82
83const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
84<html lang="zh-CN">
85<head>
86<meta charset="utf-8">
87<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
88<title>${DB} 数据库表结构</title>
89<style>
90 :root{--bg:#f5f6fa;--card:#fff;--line:#e6e8ee;--text:#1f2430;--muted:#77808f;--primary:#3b6ef6}
91 *{box-sizing:border-box}
92 body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:14px/1.6 -apple-system,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}
93 header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b6ef6,#6f8cff);color:#fff;padding:28px 32px}
94 header h1{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:22px}
95 header p{margin:0;opacity:.92;font-size:13px}
96 nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 32px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
97 nav a{color:var(--primary);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #dbe3ff;background:#f2f5ff;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px}
98 main{max-width:1200px;margin:22px auto 60px;padding:0 20px}
99 .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,30,60,.04)}
100 .card h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:18px}
101 .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:400}
102 .meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
103 table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
104 th,td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
105 th{background:#fafbff;color:#4a5262;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
106 code{background:#f1f3f9;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;font-size:12px}
107 .tag{display:inline-block;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px}
108 .pk{background:#fff1e6;color:#c26a1a}.uk{background:#e8f7ee;color:#1a8a4a}.idx{background:#eef2ff;color:#3b6ef6}
109</style>
110</head>
111<body>
112<header>
113 <h1>${DB} · 数据库表结构</h1>
114 <p>MySQL 8.4.9 · 127.0.0.1:3306 · 共 ${tbls.length} 张表 · 生成时间 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</p>
115</header>
116<nav>${nav}</nav>
117<main>
118${sections}
119</main>
120</body>
121</html>`;
122
123writeFileSync(OUT, html, 'utf8');
124console.log(`已生成 ${OUT}：${tbls.length} 张表，${cols.length} 个字段，${idx.length} 个索引`);

export-db-html.ps1 scripts/export-db-html.ps1 109 行 VS Code 打开
1﻿$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
2$mysql = 'C:\dev\mysql-8.4.9-winx64\bin\mysql.exe'
3$db = 'note_workshop'
4$outHtml = 'C:\Users\王准\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\note-workshop\docs\数据库表结构.html'
5$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("dbschema-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
6New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmp | Out-Null
7
8function Q($sql, $file) {
9 $path = Join-Path $tmp $file
10 $args = @('-u','root','-p123456','-h','127.0.0.1','--batch','--raw','--default-character-set=utf8mb4',$db,'-e',$sql)
11 $p = Start-Process -FilePath $mysql -ArgumentList $args -RedirectStandardOutput $path -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $tmp 'err.txt') -NoNewWindow -Wait
12 return $path
13}
14
15$colsFile = Q "SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_KEY,IFNULL(COLUMN_DEFAULT,'') AS COL_DEFAULT,EXTRA,COLUMN_COMMENT FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$db' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION" 'cols.tsv'
16$idxFile = Q "SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,GROUP_CONCAT(COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY SEQ_IN_INDEX) AS IDX_COLS FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$db' GROUP BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME" 'idx.tsv'
17$tblFile = Q "SELECT TABLE_NAME,TABLE_COMMENT,TABLE_ROWS FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='$db' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME" 'tbl.tsv'
18
19function ReadTsv($path) {
20 $lines = Get-Content $path -Encoding UTF8
21 if ($lines.Count -le 1) { return @() }
22 $header = $lines[0] -split "`t"
23 $rows = @()
24 for ($i = 1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
25 if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lines[$i])) { continue }
26 $cells = $lines[$i] -split "`t"
27 $o = [ordered]@{}
28 for ($j = 0; $j -lt $header.Count; $j++) { $o[$header[$j]] = if ($j -lt $cells.Count) { $cells[$j] } else { '' } }
29 $rows += [pscustomobject]$o
30 }
31 return $rows
32}
33
34$cols = ReadTsv $colsFile
35$idx = ReadTsv $idxFile
36$tbls = ReadTsv $tblFile
37
38function Esc($s) { if ($null -eq $s) { return '' }; return [System.Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode([string]$s) }
39
40$sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
41[void]$sb.AppendLine('<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8">')
42[void]$sb.AppendLine('<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">')
43[void]$sb.AppendLine('<title>note_workshop 数据库表结构</title>')
44[void]$sb.AppendLine(@'
45<style>
46 :root{--bg:#f5f6fa;--card:#fff;--line:#e6e8ee;--text:#1f2430;--muted:#77808f;--primary:#3b6ef6}
47 *{box-sizing:border-box}
48 body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:14px/1.6 -apple-system,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}
49 header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b6ef6,#6f8cff);color:#fff;padding:28px 32px}
50 header h1{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:22px}
51 header p{margin:0;opacity:.9;font-size:13px}
52 nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 32px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
53 nav a{color:var(--primary);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #dbe3ff;background:#f2f5ff;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px}
54 main{max-width:1200px;margin:22px auto 60px;padding:0 20px}
55 .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,30,60,.04)}
56 .card h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:18px}
57 .meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
58 table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
59 th,td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
60 th{background:#fafbff;color:#4a5262;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
61 code{background:#f1f3f9;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;font-size:12px}
62 .tag{display:inline-block;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px}
63 .pk{background:#fff1e6;color:#c26a1a}.uk{background:#e8f7ee;color:#1a8a4a}.idx{background:#eef2ff;color:#3b6ef6}
64 .empty{color:#a0a6b4}
65</style></head><body>
66'@)
67[void]$sb.AppendLine('<header><h1>note_workshop · 数据库表结构</h1>')
68[void]$sb.AppendLine("<p>MySQL 8.4.9 · 127.0.0.1:3306 · 共 $($tbls.Count) 张表 · 生成时间 $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')</p></header>")
69
70[void]$sb.AppendLine('<nav>')
71foreach ($t in $tbls) { [void]$sb.AppendLine("<a href=`"#t-$($t.TABLE_NAME)`">$($t.TABLE_NAME)</a>") }
72[void]$sb.AppendLine('</nav><main>')
73
74foreach ($t in $tbls) {
75 $name = $t.TABLE_NAME
76 $comment = if ($t.TABLE_COMMENT) { $t.TABLE_COMMENT } else { '' }
77 $tcols = $cols | Where-Object { $_.TABLE_NAME -eq $name }
78 $tidx = $idx | Where-Object { $_.TABLE_NAME -eq $name }
79 [void]$sb.AppendLine("<section class=`"card`" id=`"t-$name`">")
80 [void]$sb.AppendLine("<h2>$name <span class=`"empty`">$comment</span></h2>")
81 [void]$sb.AppendLine("<div class=`"meta`">约 $($t.TABLE_ROWS) 行（InnoDB 估算） · $($tcols.Count) 个字段 · $($tidx.Count) 个索引</div>")
82 [void]$sb.AppendLine('<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>字段</th><th>类型</th><th>可空</th><th>键</th><th>默认</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
83 $n = 0
84 foreach ($c in $tcols) {
85 $n++
86 $key = $c.COLUMN_KEY
87 $keyHtml = switch ($key) { 'PRI' { '<span class="tag pk">PK</span>' } 'UNI' { '<span class="tag uk">UNI</span>' } 'MUL' { '<span class="tag idx">IDX</span>' } default { '' } }
88 $def = $c.COL_DEFAULT
89 [void]$sb.AppendLine("<tr><td>$n</td><td><code>$(Esc $c.COLUMN_NAME)</code></td><td><code>$(Esc $c.COLUMN_TYPE)</code></td><td>$(Esc $c.IS_NULLABLE)</td><td>$keyHtml</td><td>$(Esc $def)</td><td>$(Esc $c.COLUMN_COMMENT)</td></tr>")
90 }
91 [void]$sb.AppendLine('</tbody></table>')
92 if ($tidx.Count -gt 0) {
93 [void]$sb.AppendLine('<div class="meta" style="margin-top:10px">索引</div><table><thead><tr><th>名称</th><th>唯一</th><th>字段</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
94 foreach ($i in $tidx) {
95 $u = if ($i.NON_UNIQUE -eq '0') { '是' } else { '否' }
96 $colsStr = $i.IDX_COLS
97 [void]$sb.AppendLine("<tr><td><code>$(Esc $i.INDEX_NAME)</code></td><td>$u</td><td>$(Esc $colsStr)</td></tr>")
98 }
99 [void]$sb.AppendLine('</tbody></table>')
100 }
101 [void]$sb.AppendLine('</section>')
102}
103
104[void]$sb.AppendLine('</main></body></html>')
105
106[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($outHtml, $sb.ToString(), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
107Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
108Write-Output "已生成: $outHtml"
109

44 'GET /api/admin/notes': ['笔记列表（可筛选状态）', 'listAllNotes'],

46 'GET /api/admin/dashboard': ['后台数据概览', 'adminDashboard'],
47 'GET /api/admin/ai/stats': ['AI 调用统计', 'aiStats'],
48 'DELETE /api/comments/{id}': ['删除自己的评论', 'deleteComment'],
49 'DELETE /api/ai/sessions/{id}': ['删除会话', 'deleteAiSession'],
50 'DELETE /api/admin/comments/{id}': ['管理员删除评论', 'adminDeleteComment'],
51};
52
53const TAG_DESCRIPTIONS = {
54 认证与用户: '注册、登录、个人资料',
55 笔记: '笔记增删改查、我的笔记、点赞',
56 公开接口: '无需登录的浏览接口',
57 评论: '评论、二级回复、删除',
58 关注与作者: '关注/取关、粉丝、热门作者',
59 管理后台: '用户管理、笔记审核与下架、评论管理、AI 统计',
60 'AI 助手': '阅读辅助（总结/人群/评分）与智能客服',
61 文件上传: '头像、笔记配图上传',
62};
63
64const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/v3/api-docs.yaml`);
65if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`拉取 OpenAPI 失败: HTTP ${res.status}`);
66const spec = yaml.load(await res.text());
67
68let n = 0;
69for (const [path, ops] of Object.entries(spec.paths || {})) {
70 for (const [method, op] of Object.entries(ops)) {
71 const key = `${method.toUpperCase()} ${path}`;
72 const hit = OPS[key];
73 if (hit) {
74 op.summary = hit[0];
75 op.operationId = hit[1];
76 n++;
77 } else {
78 op.summary = op.summary || `${method.toUpperCase()} ${path}`;
79 op.operationId = op.operationId || `${method}${path.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}`;
80 }
81 }
82}
83
84spec.info = {
85 ...spec.info,
86 title: '笔记工坊 Note-Workshop API',
87 version: '1.0.0',
88 description: [
89 '面向在校学生的读书笔记社区后端接口（V1 全功能）。',
90 '',
91 '- 统一响应：`{ code, message, data }`，`code=0` 成功；401 未登录、403 无权限、404 不存在、503 AI 未配置',
92 '- 鉴权：除 `/api/auth/**`、`/api/public/**` 外需 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`',
93 '- 管理接口 `/api/admin/**` 需要 ADMIN 角色（默认账号 admin / admin123）',
94 ].join('\n'),
95};
96spec.servers = [{ url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8080', description: '本地开发环境' }];
97
98const usedTags = new Set();
99for (const ops of Object.values(spec.paths || {})) {
100 for (const op of Object.values(ops)) {
101 (op.tags || []).forEach((t) => usedTags.add(t));
102 }
103}
104spec.tags = [...usedTags].map((name) => ({ name, description: TAG_DESCRIPTIONS[name] || '' }));
105
106mkdirSync('docs', { recursive: true });
107writeFileSync('docs/openapi.yaml', yaml.dump(spec, { lineWidth: 120, noRefs: true }), 'utf8');
108console.log(`已生成 docs/openapi.yaml：${Object.keys(spec.paths).length} 个路径，42 个操作中补全 ${n} 个 summary`);
109
