import-to-apifox.ps1 scripts/import-to-apifox.ps1 164 行 VS Code 打开
1﻿<#
2.SYNOPSIS
3 将 docs/apifox-openapi.yaml 导入 Apifox 项目。
4
5.DESCRIPTION
6 调用 Apifox 开放 API：POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/import-openapi
7 访问令牌通过 Read-Host 安全输入，不回显、不落盘。
8
9.EXAMPLE
10 .\import-to-apifox.ps1 -ProjectId 123456
11
12.EXAMPLE
13 .\import-to-apifox.ps1 -ProjectId 123456 -DryRun
14#>
15[CmdletBinding()]
16param(
17 [string]$ProjectId,
18 [string]$FilePath,
19 [ValidateSet('AUTO_MERGE', 'OVERWRITE_EXISTING', 'KEEP_EXISTING', 'CREATE_NEW')]
20 [string]$Overwrite = 'AUTO_MERGE',
21 [switch]$DryRun
22)
23
24Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
25$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
26
27if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($FilePath)) {
28 $FilePath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\docs\apifox-openapi.yaml'
29}
30
31if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 6) {
32 [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
33}
34
35$FilePath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $FilePath).Path
36$yamlText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $FilePath -Raw -Encoding UTF8
37if ($yamlText -notmatch '(?m)^openapi:\s*3\.') {
38 throw "不是 OpenAPI 3.x 文件：$FilePath"
39}
40
41if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ProjectId)) {
42 if ($DryRun) {
43 $ProjectId = '0'
44 } else {
45 $ProjectId = Read-Host '请输入 Apifox 项目 ID（项目设置 → 基本设置）'
46 }
47}
48$ProjectId = $ProjectId.Trim()
49if ($ProjectId -notmatch '^\d+$') {
50 throw "项目 ID 应为数字，当前值：$ProjectId"
51}
52
53function ConvertTo-JsonString {
54 param([string]$Value)
55 $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder ($Value.Length + 16)
56 foreach ($ch in $Value.ToCharArray()) {
57 $code = [int]$ch
58 if ($ch -eq '"') { [void]$sb.Append('\"') }
59 elseif ($ch -eq '\') { [void]$sb.Append('\\') }
60 elseif ($ch -eq "`b") { [void]$sb.Append('\b') }
61 elseif ($ch -eq "`f") { [void]$sb.Append('\f') }
62 elseif ($ch -eq "`n") { [void]$sb.Append('\n') }
63 elseif ($ch -eq "`r") { [void]$sb.Append('\r') }
64 elseif ($ch -eq "`t") { [void]$sb.Append('\t') }
65 elseif ($code -lt 0x20) { [void]$sb.Append(('\u{0:x4}' -f $code)) }
66 else { [void]$sb.Append($ch) }
67 }
68 return $sb.ToString()
69}
70
71$options = @{
72 endpointOverwriteBehavior = $Overwrite
73 schemaOverwriteBehavior = $Overwrite
74 updateFolderOfChangedEndpoint = $true
75 prependBasePath = $false
76}
77$optionsJson = $options | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
78$json = '{"input":"' + (ConvertTo-JsonString -Value $yamlText) + '","options":' + $optionsJson + '}'
79$body = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($json)
80
81Write-Host ''
82Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan
83Write-Host ' 笔记工坊 → Apifox 导入' -ForegroundColor Cyan
84Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan
85Write-Host "文件：$FilePath"
86Write-Host "项目：$ProjectId"
87Write-Host ("请求体：{0:N0} 字节" -f $body.Length)
88
89if ($DryRun) {
90 $parsed = $json | ConvertFrom-Json
91 if ($parsed.input -ne $yamlText) {
92 throw '请求体 JSON 校验失败：input 与源文件不一致'
93 }
94 Write-Host '[DryRun] JSON 合法、input 与源文件一致，未发送请求。' -ForegroundColor Yellow
95 exit 0
96}
97
98$secure = Read-Host '请输入 Apifox 系统级访问令牌（输入不回显）' -AsSecureString
99$bstr = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secure)
100try {
101 $token = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($bstr)
102} finally {
103 [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($bstr)
104}
105$token = $token.Trim()
106if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) {
107 throw '令牌为空，已取消。'
108}
109
110$uri = "https://api.apifox.com/v1/projects/$ProjectId/import-openapi?locale=zh-CN"
111$headers = @{
112 'X-Apifox-Api-Version' = '2024-03-28'
113 'Authorization' = "Bearer $token"
114}
115
116Write-Host ''
117Write-Host '正在导入，请稍候...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
118try {
119 $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $uri -Method Post -Headers $headers -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 180
120} catch {
121 $detail = $_.ErrorDetails.Message
122 if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($detail)) {
123 $detail = $_.Exception.Message
124 }
125 Write-Host ''
126 Write-Host '[失败] 导入请求出错' -ForegroundColor Red
127 Write-Host $detail -ForegroundColor Red
128 if ($detail -match '401') {
129 Write-Host '提示：令牌无效或过期，请重新生成「系统级访问令牌」。'
130 } elseif ($detail -match '403') {
131 Write-Host '提示：令牌无权访问该项目，或项目 ID 不正确。'
132 } elseif ($detail -match '404') {
133 Write-Host '提示：项目不存在，请检查项目 ID。'
134 }
135 exit 1
136} finally {
137 $token = $null
138}
139
140$c = $resp.data.counters
141Write-Host ''
142Write-Host '[成功] 导入完成' -ForegroundColor Green
143Write-Host (" 接口：新增 {0} / 更新 {1} / 失败 {2} / 忽略 {3}" -f $c.endpointCreated, $c.endpointUpdated, $c.endpointFailed, $c.endpointIgnored)
144Write-Host (" 模型：新增 {0} / 更新 {1} / 失败 {2} / 忽略 {3}" -f $c.schemaCreated, $c.schemaUpdated, $c.schemaFailed, $c.schemaIgnored)
145Write-Host (" 目录：新增 {0} / 更新 {1}" -f $c.endpointFolderCreated, $c.endpointFolderUpdated)
146
147$errorItems = @()
148$errorsProp = $resp.data.PSObject.Properties['errors']
149if ($errorsProp) {
150 $errorItems = @($errorsProp.Value)
151}
152if ($errorItems.Count -gt 0) {
153 Write-Host ''
154 Write-Host '[!] 部分资源导入失败：' -ForegroundColor Yellow
155 foreach ($item in $errorItems) {
156 Write-Host (" [{0}] {1}" -f $item.code, $item.message) -ForegroundColor Yellow
157 }
158 exit 1
159}
160
161if ([int]$c.endpointFailed -gt 0 -or [int]$c.schemaFailed -gt 0) {
162 exit 1
163}
164
list-inventory.mjs scripts/list-inventory.mjs 100 行 VS Code 打开
1// 生成项目清单：接口用例、数据表、REST 接口
2// 用法：node scripts/list-inventory.mjs
3import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
4import yaml from 'js-yaml';
5
6const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8080';
7
8// ---------- 1. 接口用例 ----------
9const testSrc = readFileSync('scripts/api-test.mjs', 'utf8');
10const tests = [...testSrc.matchAll(/await t\('([^']+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
11
12// ---------- 2. 数据表 ----------
13const schema = readFileSync('sql/schema.sql', 'utf8');
14const tables = [];
15const tableRe = /CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?(\w+)`? \(([\s\S]*?)\) ENGINE=([^;]*);/g;
16let m;
17while ((m = tableRe.exec(schema)) !== null) {
18 const name = m[1];
19 const body = m[2];
20 const tail = m[3];
21 const comment = (tail.match(/COMMENT='([^']*)'/) || [])[1] || '';
22 const colLines = body.split('\n');
23 const firstKey = colLines.findIndex((l) => /^\s*(PRIMARY KEY|UNIQUE KEY|KEY)\b/.test(l));
24 const columnBlock = firstKey === -1 ? colLines : colLines.slice(0, firstKey);
25 const columns = columnBlock.filter((l) => /^\s{2}`?\w+`?\s+(bigint|int|tinyint|smallint|varchar|char|text|datetime|timestamp|decimal|json)\b/i.test(l)).length;
26 const keys = [...body.matchAll(/^\s*(UNIQUE KEY|KEY|PRIMARY KEY)\s*`?(\w+)`?\s*\(([^)]*)\)/gm)]
27 .map((k) => `${k[1]} ${k[2]}(${k[3].replace(/`/g, '')})`);
28 tables.push({ name, comment, columns, keys });
29}
30
31// ---------- 3. REST 接口 ----------
32const spec = await (await fetch(`${BASE}/v3/api-docs`)).json();
33const summaries = {};
34if (existsSync('docs/openapi.yaml')) {
35 const doc = yaml.load(readFileSync('docs/openapi.yaml', 'utf8'));
36 for (const [p, item] of Object.entries(doc.paths || {})) {
37 for (const [method, op] of Object.entries(item)) {
38 if (op && op.summary) summaries[`${method.toUpperCase()} ${p}`] = op.summary;
39 }
40 }
41}
42const ops = [];
43for (const [path, item] of Object.entries(spec.paths || {})) {
44 for (const [method, op] of Object.entries(item)) {
45 if (!['get', 'post', 'put', 'delete', 'patch'].includes(method)) continue;
46 const tag = (op.tags && op.tags[0]) || '未分组';
47 const auth = path.startsWith('/api/public') || path.startsWith('/api/auth') || path === '/api/health'
48 ? '公开'
49 : path.startsWith('/api/admin')
50 ? 'ADMIN'
51 : '登录';
52 const key = `${method.toUpperCase()} ${path}`;
53 ops.push({ method: method.toUpperCase(), path, tag, summary: summaries[key] || op.summary || '', auth });
54 }
55}
56const TAG_ORDER = ['认证与用户', '笔记', '公开接口', '评论', '关注与作者', '管理后台', 'AI 助手', '文件上传'];
57ops.sort((a, b) => {
58 const ta = TAG_ORDER.indexOf(a.tag);
59 const tb = TAG_ORDER.indexOf(b.tag);
60 if (ta !== tb) return (ta === -1 ? 99 : ta) - (tb === -1 ? 99 : tb);
61 return a.path.localeCompare(b.path) || a.method.localeCompare(b.method);
62});
63
64// ---------- 输出 ----------
65const lines = [];
66lines.push('# 项目清单：56 个用例 · 10 张表 · 42 个接口', '');
67lines.push('> 自动生成：`node scripts/list-inventory.mjs`');
68lines.push(`> 数据来源：\`scripts/api-test.mjs\`、\`sql/schema.sql\`、\`${BASE}/v3/api-docs\``, '');
69lines.push(`统计：**${tests.length}** 个接口用例、**${tables.length}** 张表、**${ops.length}** 个接口。`, '');
70
71lines.push(`## 一、接口用例（${tests.length} 个）`, '');
72lines.push('| # | 用例 | # | 用例 |');
73lines.push('| --- | --- | --- | --- |');
74for (let i = 0; i < tests.length; i += 2) {
75 const a = tests[i];
76 const b = tests[i + 1] || '';
77 lines.push(`| ${i + 1} | ${a} | ${b ? i + 2 : ''} | ${b} |`);
78}
79lines.push('');
80
81lines.push(`## 二、数据表（${tables.length} 张）`, '');
82lines.push('| # | 表名 | 说明 | 字段数 | 主键 / 索引 |');
83lines.push('| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |');
84tables.forEach((t, i) => {
85 lines.push(`| ${i + 1} | \`${t.name}\` | ${t.comment} | ${t.columns} | ${t.keys.join('<br>')} |`);
86});
87lines.push('');
88
89lines.push(`## 三、REST 接口（${ops.length} 个）`, '');
90lines.push('| # | 分组 | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 | 鉴权 |');
91lines.push('| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |');
92ops.forEach((o, i) => {
93 lines.push(`| ${i + 1} | ${o.tag} | ${o.method} | \`${o.path}\` | ${o.summary} | ${o.auth} |`);
94});
95lines.push('');
96
97mkdirSync('docs', { recursive: true });
98writeFileSync('docs/项目清单.md', lines.join('\n'), 'utf8');
99console.log(`已生成 docs/项目清单.md：${tests.length} 用例 / ${tables.length} 表 / ${ops.length} 接口`);
100

ui-check.mjs scripts/ui-check.mjs 103 行 VS Code 打开
1// 浏览器端联调检查：真实渲染 Vue 页面，收集控制台错误并截图
2// 用法：node scripts/ui-check.mjs [frontendBase] [apiBase]
3import puppeteer from 'puppeteer-core';
4import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
5
6const WEB = process.argv[2] || 'http://127.0.0.1:8081';
7const API = process.argv[3] || 'http://127.0.0.1:8080';
8const EDGE = 'C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe';
9const OUT = '.ui-check/shots';
10
11mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
12
13const results = [];
14const consoleErrors = [];
15
16const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
17 executablePath: EDGE,
18 headless: 'new',
19 args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--lang=zh-CN'],
20});
21
22async function newPage() {
23 const page = await browser.newPage();
24 await page.setViewport({ width: 1440, height: 900, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
25 page.on('console', (msg) => {
26 if (msg.type() === 'error') consoleErrors.push(`[console] ${msg.text()}`);
27 });
28 page.on('pageerror', (err) => consoleErrors.push(`[pageerror] ${err.message}`));
29 return page;
30}
31
32async function login(page, username, password) {
33 await page.goto(`${WEB}/login`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });
34 const ok = await page.evaluate(async ({ username, password }) => {
35 const res = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
36 method: 'POST',
37 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
38 body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
39 });
40 const body = await res.json();
41 if (body.code !== 0) return body.message;
42 localStorage.setItem('nw_token', body.data.token);
43 localStorage.setItem('nw_user', JSON.stringify(body.data.user));
44 return null;
45 }, { username, password });
46 if (ok) throw new Error('登录失败：' + ok);
47}
48
49async function visit(page, path, name, expectText) {
50 const errorsBefore = consoleErrors.length;
51 await page.goto(`${WEB}${path}`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });
52 await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
53 const info = await page.evaluate(() => ({
54 title: document.title,
55 text: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 160),
56 appHtmlLength: document.querySelector('#app')?.innerHTML.length || 0,
57 }));
58 await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${name}.png`, fullPage: false });
59 const newErrors = consoleErrors.slice(errorsBefore);
60 const pass = info.appHtmlLength > 200 && (!expectText || info.text.includes(expectText)) && newErrors.length === 0;
61 results.push({ path, name, pass, title: info.title, sample: info.text, errors: newErrors });
62 console.log(`${pass ? '✓' : '✗'} ${path} title="${info.title}" app=${info.appHtmlLength}${newErrors.length ? ' errors=' + newErrors.length : ''}`);
63}
64
65const page = await newPage();
66try {
67 // 游客可访问
68 await page.goto(`${WEB}/`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });
69 await visit(page, '/', '01-home', '笔记工坊');
70 await visit(page, '/login', '02-login', '登录');
71 await visit(page, '/register', '03-register', '注册');
72
73 // 公开笔记详情（取接口里第一篇）
74 const noteId = await page.evaluate(async () => {
75 const res = await fetch('/api/public/notes?page=1&size=1');
76 const body = await res.json();
77 return body.data?.records?.[0]?.id || null;
78 });
79 if (noteId) await visit(page, `/notes/${noteId}`, '04-note-detail');
80
81 // 普通用户
82 await login(page, 'demo01', '123456');
83 await visit(page, '/me', '05-my-notes', '我的笔记');
84 await visit(page, '/notes/new', '06-note-editor', '笔记');
85 await visit(page, '/profile', '07-profile');
86 await visit(page, '/ai', '08-ai', 'AI');
87 if (noteId) await visit(page, `/notes/${noteId}/edit`, '09-note-edit');
88
89 // 管理员
90 await login(page, 'admin', 'admin123');
91 await visit(page, '/admin', '10-admin', '管理');
92} finally {
93 await browser.close();
94}
95
96const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.pass);
97console.log(`\n结果：${results.length - failed.length}/${results.length} 页面通过，控制台错误 ${consoleErrors.length} 条`);
98if (failed.length) {
99 console.log('失败页面：');
100 failed.forEach((f) => console.log(` - ${f.path} errors=${JSON.stringify(f.errors)} sample="${f.sample}"`));
101}
102process.exitCode = failed.length ? 1 : 0;
103
ui-flow.mjs scripts/ui-flow.mjs 97 行 VS Code 打开
1// 真实用户流程联调：表单登录 → 发布笔记（进入待审核）→ 验证接口数据
2// 用法：node scripts/ui-flow.mjs [frontendBase]
3import puppeteer from 'puppeteer-core';
4import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
5
6const WEB = process.argv[2] || 'http://127.0.0.1:8081';
7const EDGE = 'C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe';
8const OUT = '.ui-check/shots';
9mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
10
11const errors = [];
12const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
13 executablePath: EDGE,
14 headless: 'new',
15 args: ['--no-sandbox', '--lang=zh-CN'],
16});
17const page = await browser.newPage();
18await page.setViewport({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
19page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(m.text()); });
20page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(e.message));
21
22let pass = true;
23const check = (cond, msg) => {
24 console.log(`${cond ? '✓' : '✗'} ${msg}`);
25 if (!cond) pass = false;
26};
27
28try {
29 // 1. 表单登录
30 await page.goto(`${WEB}/login`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });
31 await page.type('#login-username', 'demo01');
32 await page.type('#login-password', '123456');
33 await Promise.all([
34 page.waitForResponse((r) => r.url().includes('/api/auth/login'), { timeout: 15000 }),
35 page.click('button[type="submit"]'),
36 ]);
37 await page.waitForFunction(() => location.pathname === '/', { timeout: 15000 });
38 const token = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('nw_token'));
39 check(Boolean(token), '表单登录成功并跳转首页，token 已写入 localStorage');
40
41 // 2. 发布公开笔记
42 const title = `联调测试笔记 ${Date.now()}`;
43 await page.goto(`${WEB}/notes/new`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });
44 await page.type('#note-book', '联调测试书目');
45 await page.type('#note-title', title);
46 await page.type('#note-content', '这是通过浏览器真实表单提交的联调测试笔记内容。');
47 await page.click('input[value="1"]');
48 const [resp] = await Promise.all([
49 page.waitForResponse((r) => r.url().includes('/api/notes') && r.request().method() === 'POST', { timeout: 15000 }),
50 page.click('button[type="submit"]'),
51 ]);
52 const body = await resp.json();
53 check(body.code === 0, `发布接口返回 code=0（${body.message}）`);
54
55 await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
56 await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/11-publish-flow.png` });
57
58 // 3. 校验数据：新笔记状态应为待审核(2)
59 const mine = await page.evaluate(async (title) => {
60 const token = localStorage.getItem('nw_token');
61 const res = await fetch('/api/notes/mine?page=1&size=20', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
62 const body = await res.json();
63 return body.data.records.find((n) => n.title === title) || null;
64 }, title);
65 check(Boolean(mine), '我的笔记接口能查到刚发布的笔记');
66 check(mine && mine.status === 2, `新公开笔记状态为待审核（实际 ${mine && mine.status}）`);
67
68 // 4. 校验公开列表不包含待审核笔记
69 const inPublic = await page.evaluate(async (title) => {
70 const res = await fetch('/api/public/notes?page=1&size=50');
71 const body = await res.json();
72 return body.data.records.some((n) => n.title === title);
73 }, title);
74 check(!inPublic, '待审核笔记未出现在公开列表');
75
76 // 5. 退出登录
77 await page.goto(`${WEB}/`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });
78 await page.evaluate(() => {
79 localStorage.removeItem('nw_token');
80 localStorage.removeItem('nw_user');
81 });
82 const guestToken = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('nw_token'));
83 check(guestToken === null, '清除登录态后 localStorage 已无 token');
84} catch (e) {
85 console.error('流程异常：', e.message);
86 pass = false;
87} finally {
88 await browser.close();
89}
90
91if (errors.length) {
92 console.log(`控制台错误 ${errors.length} 条：`, errors.slice(0, 3));
93 pass = false;
94}
95console.log(pass ? '\n联调流程全部通过' : '\n联调流程存在失败项');
96process.exitCode = pass ? 0 : 1;
97
